I can’t explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it – there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

| |

| | | Friend,

I can't explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it - there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

Unfortunately, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with conservatives like you.

**With that being said, could you do me the simple favor of just reading this all the way through to the end?** If you get to the end and still don't think you have the power to make a difference, then I just want to thank you for your time.

While roughly 35% of supporters open these messages, only an average of 1% of supporters will step up to donate, which makes it difficult since I rely on Americans like you receiving this message to hit my fundraising goals.

I refuse to rely on billionaires and Wall Street executives for money. I want our conservative values fueled by the people who believe in them most - you and me.

**And you know what?** If everyone who opened this email gave just $1 - __one single dollar__ - we'd be able to hit all of our goals.

But I’ve fallen behind in the fundraising race by more than 3 to 1. We’re asking a lot of you, but we’ll never catch up with Jon Tester at our current pace.

[Watch a special message from Don Jr. and Tim Sheehy ->](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=c2f92fd02b9344d3a4a2821135364774&_e=sJ7rlohqGWIgNsTjtFPTbZo-qbEC06n0Tmu2WQZb4dpA2gpprIO0adf29t-6tilvw_igDz3tgtZyPpL4tRDLE9p-N5nqrpTRILdtrz_v5Cr-2-UWItbg_62mu0a-ALVpreMjV2tLXi9U0IfHN2YpvlqwzKUUopwEE2mqf5NwRZVFt5_4R39eK1h_OLR9iXQ95F-2KYLVPyJt7InUwugH_KBlN88bYM6cbXuyyhmVatWJgkheDyXfDQCs8-fkcE-GUFqrbN6rZlTwsf-CJqV1Rp4frTt49P8RC1WNv-toNGFRV2NWftUgoHR8Pisf1PH3bou54Sv5nAbtBDXsmMup37lUxNFE8avl5meTMhLWSPtKmoQ-WFHt_QmeUaLd41FTWfRNwOOIlPKc1Rzmef1U-Q%3D%3D) **

****

Montana deserves better than a senator who campaigns on being a moderate but votes with Democrat Joe Biden 91% of the time.

We deserve better than a liberal career politician who took more cash from DC lobbyists than any other remember of Congress.

**Jon Tester is bought and paid for by the Democrat establishment.**

If we fail, he will buy another six-year term in the U.S. Senate like he always does , and our shot at the majority will be lost for the next decade. But if you and every freedom-loving American reading this right now act on this request for help, we’ve got a real shot to take down the Beltway’s favorite insider. But please, don’t take my word for it. You know Don Jr., one of our campaign’s most dedicated supporters and one of the most patriotic Americans I know. He’s vouching for my candidacy, and I hope his support encourages you to join us. ** Montana deserves better than a senator who campaigns on being a moderate but votes with Democrat Joe Biden 91% of the time. We deserve better than a liberal career politician who took more cash from DC lobbyists than any other remember of Congress. Jon Tester is bought and paid for by the Democrat establishment. First and foremost, Jon Tester is a fraud, and Montana deserves better. But I’m running FOR AMERICA , and the winner of this race will cast the deciding vote for the Senate majority. I’m proud to have the endorsement of Don Jr., and I hope you’ll honor me with your support today, too. Don’t miss Don Jr’s. message here -> For America's Future, Tim Sheehy Republican for U.S. Senate, Montana | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL." * | PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA | Tim Sheehy is a former Navy SEAL. name: Stephanie Mohr
subject: Pardoned by Trump
body:
| |

Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I’m asking you to sign this **[**Emergency Pardon Petition**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdar5gd3ls13e50vlb995fs7quqvnmf5fh0q43tg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cpj6apj6c9h2bs)** because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck – and involved the department’s helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home – and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver’s side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage.When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.)No doubt Eric saved his partner’s life that afternoon – and probably his own.**But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench.** Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric’s case – exhausting his options through the justice system._Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won!_**A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric’s last remaining options for freedom.****[Now you know why I’m asking you to follow this link to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition right away.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdcs5a82saht0ee99i90s7sl4i55fj5meisp7ndg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cpj6apj6c9h2bs)** My name is Stephanie Mohr and I’m proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund – a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom.I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George’s County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book – including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect’s civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials – in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me – I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones – not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense – but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name.That’s why I can’t turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. **And I hope you won’t either.** **[**Will you sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Missouri Governor Mike Parson right away?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zooi3i12qtuk34qcl6p47ngccb4spgitglnrsuvo_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cpj6apj6c9h2bs)** Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! The reality is we can’t get back the last several months Eric has been sitting in prison or the nearly four years this nightmare has been hanging over his head.But with your help today, we can bring Eric home to his wife and three children. **[So please, won’t you take just 30 seconds of your time right now to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Governor Mike Parson?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2rlnavp3c1vufghkr6lf0r04ehpd0323f5kf2co_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cpj6apj6c9h2bs)** After signing the petition, please make a generous donation to LELDF to fund this petition and the legal defenses of eight officers (including Eric) they currently support.Remember, LELDF is able to support wrongly accused and convicted officers like Eric and me because of the generosity of patriots like you. And with a pardon the final option to secure Eric’s freedom and restore his good name, I’m begging you to [**sign the Emergency Pardon Petition today**.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zn0u1mu3hsi14ifo1rvctcefpbpa5sforfpfau6o_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cpj6apj6c9h2bs)Thank you in advance for your support.
---
| | Gratefully,
---
---
Stephanie MohrDirector, Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund P.S. Without your immediate action, Eric DeValkenaere – a decorated Kansas City Police Detective – will spend the next six years behind bars. His three beautiful children won’t have their biggest cheerleader at their graduations, maybe even their weddings. And the only way to get him out is to get Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon him. **[Will you please take 30 seconds right now to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition and help me fight for Eric’s freedom?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlktv7a9o8551fub1b8tncucp9o2r50aqb85s1rg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cpj6apj6c9h2bs)** I hope you’ll also make a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF. No matter what, please pray for Eric and his heartbroken family.
---

## Biden Still Not on Ohio's Ballot
Arguments over foreign money in state ballot campaigns [prevented Ohio lawmakers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn-NvRHBcQYyMHTJlq4drcMc8VXERA5K1H9fuXPHT9_wnt7Xdb6SVNlun3Tn2Eubaeny4nlSRivAGcccCzOwHTkabyaLaAOOa2QmDt4VH0pw2mdN4A2a4HJANMaPEkED6sloHSYH_nQGsPpsAYIlAGMG1Jylt_303WTrK5f60168n5Z2H2tce388B_sxwGWACz02fj-P6xh7l6XyABeuvHRpmzpYKknmTSWqtXXVVmlKJy7WesfsKCXK5yVZQPYwkWFLMO4xP95SqzydH1Df7iT1T6D_m-M3AAD__8LbXc8) from placing President Biden on November's general election ballot ahead of Thursday's deadline. The state House introduced a clean bill this week [allowing Biden to appear](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFyhCAQQL8GOxxYUM_CIo3dpU3pLLKemyA4QM7J32cudepXvDfv477ckQPHxzseNNUtLbhWftLSSa0k2MU2ftqIgExDkx50Z6w1N9vs0-hMP_bODKjQuN4MA5lxBG-p8x32W8MTKLCq00rduh6GdgQwajQAN4MAWguryHNNuf1MHOtOW_hJT8rtmo4mTHutZxHmTcAsYL6uq41ujXSVFxcwnylw5bUImF8iSYHWyikKmNPOSQa8DvyiXCRmksn7ImnbUq6SYvnOJB17ihLPkzAXGdOTDkdZOgwhVZnXiLrTph-bPPnz4hC49IOw6nEgh7_I-u-y3wAAAP__h15txg) on the ballot, but the state Senate attached a provision outlawing foreign contributions to state ballot measure**** campaigns. Democrats objected, and the last day legislators could pass the fix with a simple majority passed. Ohio's constitution requires [political parties](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuqzAUh_GnMZuRfWwCGRjuwpa7RFVH5MDfcCqDke0m4u2rdO78LT99n7fx5jjwvvx3G_ri4-imwk-MjdRKkh1tNfceIJgKvW51Y6w1na3W_gHjqMVDa60Ar2Z0nYP1EzUO1NmKe1JkVaOV6poLtfWVyKirIeqMI9JaWIWZS0z1V-S9rPDhjE-keopbFfq1lCML80_QIGhwj2nHK9dLfGdBw8dd0PDihHuJ6RQ0eF7WIn1M4GWXW9xxyiMGLjxlmcu5MbKc4YJ0OX8nyCMh84y9SP02WlJUpX4-XhwC50srrFo2x-HXU_688xMAAP__fXpmsA) to have a certified presidential nominee 90 days prior to November's election. The Democratic National Convention is scheduled for August 19, days after the August 7 deadline. Legislation is needed to change the mandate. Similar legislation was passed in [Alabama last week](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFutDAQhJ_GdEb22hymoPgbuvvblGgNC7eRsZHtHMrbR6ROPZ9mRt_Hc34iB477fzxorFuacan8prmTWkmws23WcSMCMg2NutedsdY427zGzTvvlh6GzgJoO2xqg1WvBlXv0KFveAQFVnVaKdc9oG8HAKMGA-AMAmgtrKKVa8rtZ-JYX7SF7_Sm3C7paML4qvUswvwTMAmYrutqo18iXeXOBUxnClx5KQKme0hSoKVyigImDOjxQLnfdTFlWXiPRQbauQS8IUmxfGWSnleK8uIQJJ4nYZYxvenwlKWXeYmoO9Vp1-RxPW-Ky6MXVu0Hcvj9Wf-09hMAAP__EwtvGw), clearing the way for Biden to appear on the state's ballot.
## DOJ Sues Iowa
The Justice Department is [suing the state of Iowa](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFygzAQRL9GdOcRJ4GhoEhD57QpGRkd0mWExEiymfx9xi5Spdlit9g37-u23AwHju7T7DTVLS1mrfykpYNWAupFN3baiJBUQ1N7bTultRp046dekl2xk3q0apX2jpvt7r2WRq_9ONyx4Qklatm1Ug5dj9fLiKjkqBAHZRDbVmhJlmvKl-_EsXrawk96Ur6saW_C5Gs9ilAfAmeBc_XkOYTXJnD2aadIZxE4m-Md8IACfxVwOg0Ec0KgWuBIgVcCkzOVCju7bGItUD3BRpayCeBez3GnWMFECys_OUBm52sBl9PjKGAyQXlwdALnJk_2ODkELv1VaOl2w2-4pv6r8TcAAP___ZB2HA) over its new illegal immigration law, along with the American Civil Liberties Union. The law allows Iowa police officers to arrest illegal immigrants who have previously been deported or barred from entering the U.S.--which the [DOJ says](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2u4yAQhZ8Gd0R4gOAULrahu9tuGU3ssTMRBgsm17pvv3K23eboFJ90fv583b-QE-f1N240ylLuOAl_093r3mhwd9fN40IEZDsa-9B765wdXPccnfU9eMTBBgqDvTr3eKB3Vz8jeveAjkcw4IzvjRn8FcLlBmDNzQIMFgH6XjlDM0upl1fhLE9a0k_5pnqZytal8SmyN2V_KYgK4nEcl5naVjhTq7Ryk3-kgtik1B8FMdPRFMS9JBaeTns2UBCNP-WmIL6bnmnHKhtl0WXRr3cTnkjP5aUXTtR0wqO9WTSuyLmJ5nKg5m3jtaJwySegOSVaMelKlOUTHqy_gQmDMUFB7Oo47wenxO0alDPrhpw-w-S_N_8NAAD__-EPfdY) is unconstitutional and a violation of federal law. Gov. Kim Reynolds [is planning](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFvszAQQH-NvSU6n8_YDB6-BelTlQ5dOiIDR3BlcATXRPn3Vdu183vS03u_9JeUS96ur2nlKHPt0yj5zr07GTgh9aSnODMjW83ReOMskQ2kl-jdkIgshCE0MLkhDOgQRgyAg2F2OkcEJHAGILgG_blFtNBaxGATojGKgKcsdT9_1LzJwnN51jvv57GuusRF5HYo-09hp7CTRxb5ZQq7l7y-8XOrZTr-fwuHJPk8FHbGh9AEMr5xrcGWqPV6j9PtkUvJR-MVwXVNufw05M_jrwAAAP__UV5TFw) to stand by the law, which goes in to effect on July 1st: "_Since President Biden refuses to enforce our nation 's immigration laws -- threatening the safety of our citizens -- Iowa will step in."_ The DOJ is asking the federal district court to block the law during the litigation.
## NYC Leads World in Millionaire Count
New York City has more millionaires than any other city in the world, [according to a new report](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQRb_GdEbjsY2hcPEaun1tSsTCsEwC9sp21tq_j0id7kr3SEc6H7fpNvPB4fF_PsmXLU7zUvhFk5UKJJrJNKvfiJB0Q145ZbUxujfN7kFrsN2K23LfjHODQ7DOqL4bVrtARw17BDRgFUBvO3TtgKhh0Ii9nhGVEgZo5RJT-xk5lJ224x1flNolns3h91KeWeh_AkeBY621Xe45UM3XL3C8psBx4fKWlcsuz5iLPPk4OIaZE2UZqMp3TF8yfJ93SlIJHJvk12e9qNw5YeBxznz8KsufAX4CAAD__0HZW64). Over 350,000 residents have "liquid, investible assets" of at least $1 million--that's one in 24 New Yorkers. The number has increased 48% since 2013. The Bay Area in California took second place with 305,000 millionaires, and Tokyo grabbed the bronze medal with 298,000.

| Friends, Make sure you tune in this Monday at noon to watch what's going on in Richmond. You can attend in person by sitting in the Senate or House gallery or you can watch online at [www.virginiageneralassembly.gov. ](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010y1fWQial7H3nfvHgp60-Yvkti8PWTZjS-6xCww5zwiOqxjBJo9in3K3bxRf98MDdCw8mawO3J2wJFC6Tx7g-RmdndpJb1YfQgrps2T3L5YV39yC99Whx24i39ZMg-jFCx5rCfPmnGXzpkj_H6IHg8GR9-ByKahpQcaPDpPhC9BWeOgpqMeHQHA4nDRbzZQWOmr75fNNotxUYiPcDbbDaXjsmc8rSwwvshMamIh8p2U3g_Wsz3uHVeusVkkAcnasRtKHS9YarKtrpxtJR76ISQ==&c=WxS2SRYJ-eIr-5wWqEFoKzslLBWh4fztyO9V16_6Plc_0oQtE3y6Hw==&ch=XQAHo_9AjDRlh2OItBpPWwV9GSN3vNCAb_53urPxrMJuaTn60BGXWA==)
Legislators return to Richmond on Monday to a renegotiated budget, which if approved by the General Assembly will go into effect July 1, 2024.
According to Delegate Luke Torian, senior Virginia lawmakers and Governor Glenn Youngkin have reached a deal on the budget. Now they need the approval of the full General Assembly to approve that budget.
In case you missed it, Governor Youngkin called for a Special Session for Monday, May 13 for the sole purpose of working on the budget.
Legislators will most likely vote on the budget on Wednesday, May 15, after the 48 hour review legal requirement so that legislators can carefully review the budget.
The Democrat controlled legislature wants to increase taxes on every Virginian. Governor Youngkin is opposing and vetoing legislation that would raise taxes on every Virginian. Monday we will find out the details of the negotiated budget. So stay tuned.
Click the links below to watch the General Assembly in action on Monday at noon.

# Governor's Budget Amendments
---
|
* Governor Youngkin has proposed a grand total of 242 amendments to budget bills HB 29 and HB 30. He wants to "preserve the vast majority of spending priorities as passed by the General Assembly."

* Governor Youngkin supports his $64 billion Common Ground Budget which eliminates all proposed tax increases, invests a record $21.2 billion in K-12 education, caps tuition increases at 3%, includes 3% pay raises for teachers and state employees in each year, and increases investments in health and human resources by $3.2 billion over the biennium.

* The budget passed by the Democrat controlled General Assembly eliminated over $850 million of the Governor's priority spending items in the introduced budget and $1 billion of tax relief; the Common Ground budget restores only $230 million of those priorities.

* The Governor's Common Ground budget includes $196 million in additional funding for at-risk students, an additional $1 billion in higher education funding, $175 million for the Housing Trust Fund, toll relief in Hampton Roads, a full funding of the state's share of WMATA's short-term funding needs, and $70 million to expedite projects on Interstate-81.

* Our reserve fund balances are among the best of any state in the nation. We have over $4.6 billion in reserve funds representing 15% of our annual general fund spending. Revenue collections are running ahead of the revenue forecast by $827 million year to date.

* In short, Virginia can fund priorities and maintain our long-term structural balance without raising taxes. The Governor proposed 1 billion in tax relief in his introduced budget, while the budget passed by the General Assembly included tax increases that would cost Virginians $2.6 billion in total. The Governor claims the Common Ground budget allows us to write a clean budget without tax increases or tax decreases.

Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [ ](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=587bb33ac26142ae91e03adace8d2807&_e=W4dUPaFTgSDyvu11FtKk6CzVoTwa_5gXZY34uQY7D3wf5TGM05ID4ooAb4K2J2ddqhyoSdR79ISUNkKZTRqEjX3Hlvf8V3ZUgSltZG3KVEXO2qTc0pi3uNc6kdqcBy7IjhEVl0a-pY89wFKRKWqcaGEH4V43TeI5k87yz2WHPO64oNDEV4LRZw6n5DBp4apPfIO9_C7A5dyrYr4Zxt4zJb2ApOLDl4mclsEFCu2vdK65m7CHgOlpajwMj2xVmIFcP069kPvYCY2aotmR-CSec7xJ3VSDuoWJbWbfFuYglFBBv8qoArsGrV_xNY0CMRypizpydsAHlwi0JN86qwmV5jzPNn9F3t8Tsorr-VtipqrLKfDcSsRh5NvxJESky7ETES8yXHvB8qouedx4aa52-Oa7euvvnndkILYj32hjUG8%3D) That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=587bb33ac26142ae91e03adace8d2807&_e=W4dUPaFTgSDyvu11FtKk6CzVoTwa_5gXZY34uQY7D3wf5TGM05ID4ooAb4K2J2ddqhyoSdR79ISUNkKZTRqEjX3Hlvf8V3ZUgSltZG3KVEXO2qTc0pi3uNc6kdqcBy7IjhEVl0a-pY89wFKRKWqcaGEH4V43TeI5k87yz2WHPO64oNDEV4LRZw6n5DBp4apPfIO9_C7A5dyrYr4Zxt4zJb2ApOLDl4mclsEFCu2vdK65m7CHgOlpajwMj2xVmIFcP069kPvYCY2aotmR-CSec1gu6hqJe3vpseaup-C_XugHX6bguhpDvtkrNH1aWrG7HHvcBVICUM3p2uSu87K4WAhL7iUn3fbQ46_ZJ_9XCSyUx9DBArTqQzW5vWswxy_mtbVnDy9vtKC4yWMWaLgTf0l9uv66EleYUQRewap8I7Y%3D)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. | |
Dear Friend of Liberty,

Imagine the horror of losing your home over an unjust foreclosure process--for decades-old, overdue property taxes. This is a harsh reality for Christine Searle, a 70-year-old homeowner in Arizona. It's an issue closely tied to the defense of property rights and our Constitution.

After 18 years of owning her home, Christine might lose it all -- along with all the value it has gained over decades -- and find herself homeless because of a $1,600 tax debt.

The government thinks that it is not enough just to pay the taxes, they want to allow private investment companies to take her house. This overreach is all too common from bureaucrats who see an opportunity to exercise government power over private citizens.

Here at the Mountain States Legal Foundation (MSLF), we believe in fighting for the rights enshrined in our Constitution, to ensure fairness, justice and freedom for all.

Christine's fight isn't just about her. It's a manifestation of a larger problem. Foreclosure laws across our country are threatening our basic rights to property. They're undermining years of equity build-up and the innocence of folks who've made every mortgage payment on time.

We're trying to set a legal precedent that defends these fundamental rights--but we can't do it alone. **Today, we're reaching out and urging you to join us in this fight.**

**Make a donation to show your support for Christine Searle and the cause of property rights!**

[https://mslegal.org/donate/searle-confirmation/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f910fe47e6a045e9979452dd486215f2&_e=G3Q92-ZzUx6TTlZcp4BtzVSsGlzj_0o1vJo4kptucPV0gWFH1oIPk4RQrZDCC1c5TLvBXnbTtbvRG1lybGPTszFUcWf4TTpANpxk-G8vtXsmSXd2Seb-aMVxE69AeiYNL6TUJ3F7P53yK_T997mv6Ny5VtKQoa4ll9V95VWB-tOJwjlBSxp2_npQIP7gKcg0e-bP82xMm15byG1tkfTu0MhRAoiD5TxNDa6pD5dLmG4p40PlWVNU8AF8EqotcaXekMew-Bahl1-MnDXIuQ47NkvFD6UMTGD7_JWwh50TFYVBL4BTfZvOP-raJTGTYknLeiLPMoqIrmuvfVD9NukM5M90VF4jS3QO4hDy4J0u7nk%3D)

Your voice matters. Let's stand together against this injustice. After all, justice for Christine is a step towards justice for all homeowners at risk of losing their property unjustly.

Thank you for your support.

For Liberty!

Cristen Wohlgemuth
President & CEO
Mountain States Legal Foundation

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: Sign the Petition: Stop grooming children in schools
body:
####
The radicals know what they’re doing.

| |
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj9d7s29tkrmcllc0dgvf405g1gpdl783occ0tcg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cpim8ob2cdh2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative, We don’t know each other but today I’m urgently asking you to sign the [**STOP GROOMING CHILDREN IN SCHOOLS Petition**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zura6kq1gfjmci4iv8pc7bkuntpjb59oobbj3tk8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cpim8ob2cdh2bs) so you can make sure what happened to the Konen family, never happens to your family. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z264dhjg558umf3j28hoq1ae686n1kuq4p2qs828_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cpim8ob2cdh2bs) Jessica Konen is a good mom. She has always been very involved in her daughter’s life. They’ve always talked. **But Jessica was shocked when she was called into her daughter’s middle school and informed by school administrators that her daughter, Alicia, was now a “boy.”** Jessica’s 12-year-old daughter’s school secretly pushed her into believing she was “transgender” and “bisexual.” Her 12-year-old didn’t even know what those words meant. But behind her mother’s back, they had _already_ given Alicia a new name, new pronouns, and were even having her use a new bathroom.And they told her to keep it a secret from her mother. They told her Jessica couldn’t be trusted. Now I want to pause right here – because right now maybe you’re thinking, **“ _My_ children and grandchildren would never fall for this nonsense.”** Or maybe you’re saying to yourself, **“This only happens when the parents aren’t involved.”**
---
| | I get it. I used to think that too. Until our phones started ringing with calls from so many good families across the country... families like yours. | [**Sign the Petition**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3veeq7ae007qjp5kmugkjg55chq4r4o6v5sghso_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cpim8ob2cdh2bs)
---

The radicals know what they’re doing.
They exploit the very innocence and trust that parents and grandparents work so hard to instill in their children.
They target kids, overwhelmingly young girls, who might be a little awkward or who don’t quite fit in...
...and they brainwash them with propaganda convincing them that their joy or salvation will come from a gender “transition.”
Then they whisper, “Now, don’t tell mom.”
Before I tell you the rest of the Konen family’s story...
[**Please follow this link right now to sign the STOP GROOMING CHILDREN IN SCHOOLS Petition.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7mn4tfssgs272ru1cp1kead83pqsvckala99s0o_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cpim8ob2cdh2bs)
Schools keeping secrets from parents must stop.
California – where the Konens live – actually has a model policy in place _requiring_ schools to keep secrets from parents.
And when Jessica pushed back, when she asked questions about it – when she fought to free her beautiful little girl from their clutches... do you know what happened?
**Child Protective Services (CPS) showed up at her home to “interview” her children.**
We don’t know who “reported” Jessica to CPS but she got the message loud and clear – support this gender “transition” – or else.
In the end, the Konens were incredibly lucky. Jessica’s daughter, Alicia, came to see the truth and they were able to break free from the clutches of the transgender movement.
But that’s not how it ends for many, many families. Maybe even yours.

**And. We. Won.**
Now they’ll think twice before they keep secrets from other parents in other school districts.
But to truly put a stop to this nonsense once and for all, we must win court victories like this in schools _all_ _over_ _America_.

And you better believe, that’s exactly what the left is counting on.

It won’t be long until someone in your family gets called into the school office like Jessica did.

**[So please help us stop them by signing the STOP GROOMING CHILDREN IN SCHOOLS Petition and making your best tax-deductible donation today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zavtdi9eck7t7fomg6kj2jbq5laank59qr9nrbno_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cpim8ob2cdh2bs)**

Former State Rep. Harol Parker Former Chair of the Carroll County Republican Committee Frank McCarthy Former State Rep. May 10, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Peltola Double Dips With Pro-Hamas Agitators

ANCHORAGE, AK - Mary Peltola's campaign is receiving funds from friends
in high places, namely friends who are simultaneously funding the
pro-Hamas protest groups on college campuses across America.

Must Read Alaska
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=67695&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=59787> reports the confusing triangulation of
money tying Peltola's campaign to what we're seeing around the country,
explaining how wealthy elitists will donate funds to the individual
campaign, as well as political action committees - who in turn fund the
campaign. Essentially, this scheme used by Peltola is just a facade to
hide from Alaskans just how hard the big pro-Hamas donors are working
to get her elected.

According to the report
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=67695&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=59787> , Susan Pritzker, sister of Illinois
Governor J.B. Pritzker and an affluent Chicago heiress of the Hyatt
Hotels family donated nearly $3,000 to the Peltola campaign, with an
additional $3,066.67 coming from other Pritzker family members. In the
same vein, the Pritzker clan, per the report, financially supports "at
least two major foundations that have been funneling money to campus
agitators through their grant making programs." And it's not just the
Pritzker's either, but the Soros family as well who have financial ties
to both Peltola and the pro-Hamas protesters.

This report comes as Peltola remains silent
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=67695&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=59788> on the ongoing war in Israel, including
Iran's attack on the country and Biden's controversial decision to
withhold certain artillery.

In response to this news, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom stated:

"The fact that Mary Peltola is receiving financial support from
individuals funding the pro-Hamas protests on our college campuses
should come as no surprise given Peltola's support for Biden's radical
agenda. The Democrats biggest donors are funding these pro-terrorist
and anti-Jewish protests we cannot remain silent. Alaskans rightfully
deserve to know who Peltola aligns herself with and the people working
to get her elected."

###

When I
was growing up, I spent most of my free time outside the home -
playing with kids in the neighborhood and hanging out with
friends at school.

Sadly,
social media has destroyed that world. Many kids today spend
hours mindlessly scrolling on their phones, cut off from the
social activities vital to their development.

This has
led to a disturbing mental health crisis among minors. And I
firmly believe we need to address the dangers of children using
social media.

That's
why I'm partnering with Senator Brian Shatz to introduce the Kids
Off Social Media Act to severely limit minors' use of social
media sites. Senator Shatz is a committed liberal, and we don't

# [Demand that the NIH retire 26 chimpanzees to sanctuary before it’s too late!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T931af39a-f597-48d2-8f9f-8ce32348f279/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | **They died awaiting freedom.** Danny, Amanda, Ann, El Rey, Fonzie, Kareem, Kim, and Martin. These are the names of some of the chimps who died at a biomedical research facility in New Mexico while the National Institutes of Health refused to move them to the Chimp Haven sanctuary, despite being required to by law. So, the [Humane Society Legislative Fund](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7e1307b3-58b1-4084-a6b4-b9edcaeff3c4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) sued. And in December 2022, a court determined that the NIH violated the CHIMP Act by denying these chimps sanctuary retirement simply because they suffer from chronic health conditions common in chimps formerly used in research. But NIH still refuses to move the remaining 26 chimps to sanctuary. These chimps were subjected to painful biomedical experiments for years. We owe them the chance to live out the rest of their lives in a sanctuary where they can climb trees, live in bonded social groups and control their own lives. **These chimps have already suffered so much at the hands of humans. We demand that they be given a chance for a better life:[Tell the NIH it's time to move these chimps to Chimp Haven](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tda2f97c8-8e5f-4556-bede-a66335598152/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**[.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te802105d-5c56-4ee6-be28-f0bf68555560/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Elissa Slotkin for Senate
subject: “If he wins.”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1417%2E135344%2EcMMqcC)

Last week, Time magazine released a long article with a chilling lede: “Donald Trump thinks he’s identified a crucial mistake of his first term: He was too nice.”
The article, titled “How Far Trump Would Go,” lays out a dark and detailed picture of Trump’s plans for a second term.
It’s worth sitting with the article, which you can read [**here**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/2508?t=2&akid=1417%2E135344%2EcMMqcC), but here are some of the key ideas Trump has previewed:
-- Red states unleashed to monitor women’s pregnancies and criminally prosecute women who obtain abortions.
-- Prosecution of political rivals and an evisceration of the nonpartisan civil service, to be replaced with loyalists.
-- The National Guard deployed, as he sees fit, to American cities.
-- Pardons for January 6th insurrectionists.
In other words, what amounts to an imperial presidency–unconstrained by norms or more rational heads, using the full power of the executive branch to enact revenge for perceived grievances and reshape American life.
We say this not to scare you, but to remind you: believe them when they tell you who they are.
If you take this threat seriously, as we do, there is only one response: strategize, plan, and get to work. We can’t change Trump and we can’t change the Republican Party, but we can beat them.
The path to the White House runs through Michigan -- and in all likelihood, if Republicans win in our race, they also win the White House and the Senate. We’re doing everything in our power to prevent that outcome, including, most importantly, building a grassroots network of people like you.
So please, take a minute to think through what Trump’s plans would mean to you and your life, and the life of your kids in a second term, and ask yourself: what if he wins?
[**There are lots of ways to get involved and help prevent that outcome, but one of these is chipping in to help us talk to more voters in one of the most important swing states.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-may24.waY6cu&refcode=em240510-1-sa&t=3&akid=1417%2E135344%2EcMMqcC)

body:
I hope you have a minute to read this
| | |
---
Friend, this message is a bit on the longer side, but I hope you'll take the time to read it. **[You see, in a lot of ways, this campaign is a love letter to Florida.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84670383/472268246/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1199-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTkyMjBhYjgtYzkwZS1lZjExLTk2ZjMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=S5ukXtfDohQ9_J4ugBF-_3hrD1GOUq2E1lxGrJbPTC8=)**
I can still remember the first time that I came to Florida. I was working on my master's degree and had just gotten the news that my beloved father had been killed by a criminal with a gun in Ecuador, where I was born. As I grappled with my grief, I found myself missing Ecuador more than I had in years. I missed its warmth, lush greenery, and close-knit communities that I grew up with. My older sister, Monica, knew our family was struggling, so she convinced me to visit her in Miami, where she had recently moved.
When I stepped outside of the airport, it was like stepping into another world. **It was warm, wonderfully humid, bustling with lively, diverse communities, lush, and all so, so beautifully green.** We spent the next few days visiting all of Monica's favorite places in her new city — the spots with the most beautiful views and the best cafes to get a _cafecito_. The people we met were even warmer than the weather. Everyone was welcoming, friendly, and proud to call this state their home.
I boarded my plane back to my home with a heavy heart but a new resolve. **As soon as I was able, I sold my car and moved across the country to live in a one room apartment in America.**(My mom, always my closest confidant, wasn't far behind.)
Since moving here all those years ago, I've had the privilege to build a beautiful life in the Sunshine State. **I fell in love here, found the community I had longed for, raised a family of my own, and dedicated my career to serving this state.** I've helped protect the Everglades, expanded access to health care, worked for Florida International University, and became the first South American immigrant elected to Congress, right here in Florida.
I've spent my life serving this state and getting to know the communities who call it home. But my opponent, Rick Scott, has spent his career scamming Floridians, lying to voters, and making himself richer. **He wants you to think that Florida families agree with his extreme, hateful agenda._But I can promise you, friend, that couldn't be further from the truth._**
Listen, my campaign is deeply personal because of my love for this state — and more importantly, because of what it will mean for my fellow Floridians. Rick Scott wants to sow division and undo decades of meaningful progress. He wants to destroy reproductive rights, gun safety laws, and vital public services, like Medicare and Social Security, that support millions of his constituents, including my own mother.

Florida is ready for a change — I hear it from voters every day as I travel around all 67 counties. I know this November, Floridians will choose unity, progress, and kindness over Rick Scott's extremist agenda.

But the truth is, we're up against a mega-millionaire who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time. If we're going to break through Rick Scott's lies, build unstoppable grassroots momentum, and win this critical race, I'll need your help.

**[Please, will you donate $5 (or whatever you can spare today) to help me defeat Rick Scott and give our home the leadership that we deserve? This _will_ be the year that we flip Florida blue, but only if grassroots activists like _you_ believe in my campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84670384/472268247/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1199-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTkyMjBhYjgtYzkwZS1lZjExLTk2ZjMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=S5ukXtfDohQ9_J4ugBF-_3hrD1GOUq2E1lxGrJbPTC8=)**

freedomva.org [freedomva.org]
Did you know we have three easy ways for you to share your story? Our organizing team has worked hard to ensure you can share your story in an easy and comfortable way.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/85567/images/Copy%20of%20Katy%20Brock%20PFML.jpg]
The easiest way is through our google form! You can find the form at our linktree in the bio of our social media pages. All you need to do is give your name, your contact information, and what issue your story relates to.
Fill out the form here [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd1corcX24sU8SGyHsLsdf0sOYMn0IUnWer5EUKDjaPTcrszw/viewform?usp=sf_link]
You can also visit our website and click on the “Share your story” [https://freedomva.org/share-your-story/] feature in the top right corner. Similar to the google form you’ll need to provide your name, contact, and a short synopsis of your story!
Our website here [freedomva.org]
Finally, our most personal way to share your story is by getting connected with one of our organizers by using the getinvolved@freedomva.org [getinvolved@freedomva.org] email address. If you provide your name, contact, and where in Virginia you’re located one of our organizers in your region can get in contact! Whether you’d like to email, have a call, chat over text, or even meet in person for a coffee our organizers will meet you where you’re most comfortable to share your story.
getinvolved@freedomva.org [getinvolved@freedomva.org?subject=Interested%20in%20sharing%20my%20story&body=]
We’re grateful for everyone who has shared their experience with us, and it is our privilege to advocate for Virginians using their own experiences!
Thank you
Rhena Hicks

### The United States Continues to Lead the Developed World in Police Murders -- But It Doesn't Have To Be This Way

As a human rights lawyer I've had the opportunity to train law enforcement on Constitutional Law--particularly on Fourth Amendment right to privacy protections during search and seizure. I always start my training with the following statement.
> You are a government agent with the ability to use lethal force. Ensuring your power is kept in check is why we have the Bill of Rights. That's why it is imperative you treat these rights as sacred, because it will determine life or death for members of the public.
Unfortunately, the United States massively leads the developed world in police killings of its residents. My critique of policing in America is not a critique of individual officers--it's a critique of a system that is failing to meet the needs of the hour because it was not built to meet the needs of the hour. The tragic murder of U.S. Airman Roger Fortson on May 3 is a painful example of that failure, and we we need change.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..eY3PsHIJBZrF7RQaNWMEg7pEpRb2j_S8CzvnQEvTsQk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144492532)
In response to a 911 call on May 3, 2024 intended for another resident of Osalooka County, Florida, Osalooka County Police arrived at around 4pm at the home of active duty U.S. Airman Roger Fortson, a 23 year old Black man, and [shot him dead](https://substack.com/redirect/fd564dc7-1dac-4f35-b916-06b7efb0b382?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b61011fa-2847-4c9c-8c00-9e357f0923d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
U.S. Senior Airman Roger Fortson. PHOTO: U.S. Air Force Via AP
The video cam footage--which I will not be showing--shows that the officer knocked on Roger Fortson's door and then moved to the side multiple times, preventing Roger from seeing who was knocking. Roger, who had been on a FaceTime call with a friend, grew concerned and retrieved his legally procured and maintained firearm. Roger opened his own door, after which the police officer appeared in front of him and within 1 second, shot him multiple times, killing him. In total, the officer shot Roger Fortson six times, while offering no explanation of who he was or why he was there. The officer made no attempt to deescalate or to give Roger the opportunity to respond to any command--he just shot Roger dead.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/be263737-0a7c-495f-96b4-ccef7483d39e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Roger's tragic murder at the hands of law enforcement is part of an epidemic of police murders in the United States--something no other developed world experiences. For example, cross the border to our northern neighbor Canada and your likelihood of being killed by law enforcement drops 3 fold. Visit New Zealand and your risk drops 15 fold. Visit Japan and your risk drops 168 fold. When [Iceland police killed a civilian in 2013](https://substack.com/redirect/91348031-42cc-4595-8c22-3986c17a2e4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--it was a first in the nation's history.
While exact numbers do not exist because law enforcement is remarkably not required to report when they kill a civilian, [experts record the number](https://substack.com/redirect/0f11deff-9819-462d-b64c-f9dc083e644f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of people law enforcement kills somewhere between 1200 and 2000 people annually. Furthermore, Black people suffer fatal police violence at a rate of nearly 3X that of white people.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0f11deff-9819-462d-b64c-f9dc083e644f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It does not have to be this way, and we can address police violence with proven methods and meaningful budget allocations in at least the following three ways.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..eY3PsHIJBZrF7RQaNWMEg7pEpRb2j_S8CzvnQEvTsQk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144492532)
**First, we must recognize that law enforcement** _**responds**_**to crime, but a living wage, food and water security, accessible healthcare, and public education** _**prevent**_**crime.** If we want safer communities, invest in people, not punishments. This means investing more in mental health professionals, suicide prevention experts, addiction experts, and social workers in general. Cities like Denver have done so by [sending mental health professionals instead of police officers](https://substack.com/redirect/8985a136-33ea-42a5-82fa-e3dd36b7afc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and have seen the positive results first hand.
**Likewise, we must end Qualified Immunity.** Qualified Immunity is not in the U.S. Constitution, not in any State Constitution, nor is it part of any state or federal legislation. It is purely Court created to protect law enforcement from accountability when they unjustly harm or kill civilians. As the Equal Justice Initiative [explains](https://substack.com/redirect/c807064c-d32a-4cff-ae9d-0871aec770dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Qualified immunity is a court-created rule that limits victims of police violence and misconduct from holding officers accountable when they violate a person's constitutional rights.
And worse, it was concocted by the Supreme Court over the course of nearly a century as a means to advance white supremacy in America. You can read a thorough analysis [here](https://substack.com/redirect/6efa19b6-aa0a-45ff-8014-6bbb6f03be04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Ending Qualified Immunity would not default condemn any police officer for an innocent wrongdoing, but it would ensure those who are harmed have their day in court to have their cases heard. It is no surprise therefore that nearly 2 in 3 Americans,[ or 62% of Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/24bf76e9-1d61-4c14-873d-e2040ec9149b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), support ending Qualified Immunity.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dc33817d-4a07-47ba-a062-d88cf60f9bc2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Photo Credit Courtesy of Megan Varner, Getty Images
**Finally, we must pass the[George Floyd Justice In Policing Act](https://substack.com/redirect/de39cfd3-d640-4cea-950d-1cce8bfa7f7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).** This act ends Qualified Immunity, bans no knock raids (like the one that killed Breonna Taylor), and ends lethal choke holds. These are all common sense steps to good policy and public safety. No person across the political spectrum should feel comfortable handing over unquestioned lethal authority to a government agent, period.
While there are _several_ more comprehensive methods to stop or decrease police violence, the aforementioned three are a strong starting point.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..eY3PsHIJBZrF7RQaNWMEg7pEpRb2j_S8CzvnQEvTsQk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144492532)
Roger Fortson was only 23 years old. He served in the armed forces. He did everything right. And still our system failed him in the most cruel and brutal manner. Like the police murders of Philando Castile, Breonna Taylor, Eric Garner, Daniel Shaver, and too many others, the police murder of Roger Fortson should be a wake up call that this method of policing is not only cruel and harmful, but also unsustainable.
Fortunately, we have the tools available to us to ensure law enforcement sacredly protects the Bill of Rights, especially when engaging with the community members they are commissioned to serve. We can enforce those protections with adequate community resources, by ending Qualified Immunity, and by passing the George Floyd Act.
Ultimately, if our elected officials are not willing to vote for legislation that will accomplish the above, and we cannot change their minds to do so, then it is critical we activate, organize, and change their seats by voting them out permanently.

Fortunately, we have the tools available to us to ensure law enforcement sacredly protects the Bill of Rights, especially when engaging with the community members they are commissioned to serve. We can enforce those protections with adequate community resources, by ending Qualified Immunity, and by passing the George Floyd Act. Ultimately, if our elected officials are not willing to vote for legislation that will accomplish the above, and we cannot change their minds to do so, then it is critical we activate, organize, and change their seats by voting them out permanently. **That’s why I’m calling on every single Democrat to throw their full support behind Jacky right now. That includes YOU, friend!**

But I also want to make this clear: I’m not just expecting you to donate because our campaign needs help reaching a fundraising goal. I’m asking for your support today because I believe in this team, this mission, and this work — and I’m hoping that, after I explain why, you will believe in it too.
**First, the stakes.** We’re just three seats away from flipping control of the House of Representatives, but if we lose this seat here in KS-03, that road becomes a LOT tougher. So this race could be the one that makes the difference between an all-out, nationwide abortion ban or a federal law protecting the right to choose in all 50 states.
**Second, my record.** Chaos and dysfunction are more likely to make front-page news, but I’m proud of what I’ve been able to get done for the people of Kansas. Working with both Republicans and Democrats, I’ve passed legislation to lower drug costs for seniors, fund critical infrastructure projects in our state, take real action to combat climate change, tackle the epidemic of gun violence, deliver critical resources for Kansas’ rural communities, and codify same-sex marriage rights into federal law.
There’s a lot more work to do — but believe me when I say I’m determined to get it done because accomplishing real change that helps people is the whole point of holding office.
**Third, my voice, and how I use it.** When I flipped a seat in Kansas to get elected, I’m proud to say I broke the mold for what people think of when they picture Congress. After all, I’m an LGBTQ+ Native American woman and former MMA fighter who was raised by a single mom and worked multiple jobs to pay my own way through school. That gives me a unique voice in Washington, and I’m determined to use it to deliver real progress for the people of Kansas.
**Finally, Friend, there’s this cold, hard reality:** this race figures to be one of the closest, hardest-fought, and most expensive in the entire country. The leading GOP super PACs have named this district a top target, and some have even started running digital ads attacking me.
Frankly, if that weren’t the case, I probably wouldn’t have had to send you this email. But this election really is that competitive, which means we can’t afford to fall behind on our fundraising.
**[Friend, if you’ve read this far, thank you. And if, after reading all that, you’re on board with this fight and what it’s all about, I’d be so grateful for any support you can provide.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84677148/472286013/1879636074?refcode=email_051024_longemail&amounts=6,20,25,50,100,250,500&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZGU0M2FhOC1kMjBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Uxe0u3siiaUxuCeuWzpFK4cbZJXVW5urvYLW-9HsRdY=)**

Peter, My name is Yassamin Ansari. I'm a daughter of immigrants, a former senior policy advisor at the United Nations, the first Iranian-American elected to public office in Arizona, and the youngest woman ever elected to the Phoenix City Council — **and I’m running for Congress.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84678793/472292099/995347201?refcode=ia_series_1_img&ms=inactive_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2Y2E2NmU4MS1kNTBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8VYTLRZWFdnQj1RfkxPCeUWwtNLC5rrh7KLkuj-fzCw=) For the past two years, I've had the honor of serving as a Phoenix City Councilwoman and now the Vice Mayor of Phoenix, representing one of the most diverse districts in the fifth-largest and fastest-growing city in the country. In that time, I've seen the unprecedented challenges facing working families in our community. I've also seen people come together, doing whatever they can to help their friends, family and neighbors build an American dream that often seems increasingly out of reach. **I'm running for Congress to secure a better future for Phoenix, Glendale, and communities like ours across the country.** We deserve real climate action, affordable housing, Medicare for All, and an economy that gives everyone the chance to build a good life for themselves and their families. That's why I've made a career of going head-to-head with corporate polluters, corrupt special interests, and tired, ineffective policies. As a senior policy advisor at the United Nations, I helped deliver the historic Paris Climate Accords and facilitated multiple global climate action summits. Here at home, I've defended reproductive rights, spearheaded Phoenix's first Climate Action Plan, secured over $100 million in new investments to combat homelessness, and brought home millions in free tuition for students seeking good jobs in the trades. That work is just the beginning. Right now, our country is at an inflection point. Our democracy is under attack, it's getting harder than ever to make ends meet, our fundamental right to exist is constantly threatened, and communities like Phoenix are on the front lines of the climate crisis. We need leaders who understand the challenges our community faces, and who will work tirelessly to solve them. [**I'm running for Congress to build a more sustainable, more equitable Phoenix & Glendale — where everyone can thrive, not just the wealthy and well-connected. I hope you'll join me.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84678794/472292100/995347201?refcode=ia_series_1_l1&ms=inactive_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2Y2E2NmU4MS1kNTBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8VYTLRZWFdnQj1RfkxPCeUWwtNLC5rrh7KLkuj-fzCw=) **[Support our campaign](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84678801/472292105/995347201?refcode=ia_series_1_b1&ms=inactive_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2Y2E2NmU4MS1kNTBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8VYTLRZWFdnQj1RfkxPCeUWwtNLC5rrh7KLkuj-fzCw=)** Thank you, Peter. — Yassamin Ansari

| | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=bb78ed1edab644269274a9ca37d2d02f&_e=y__G7Ezo4r8-DNbTiwqTTRMKYg9tefWKLUCbMLnmwFiGTe-9-tambxPeKO_V14QCxCiuuI9eFCiHqTCeasXKcrHuL3FWssG2xHb02Huollmhm_lHv9hpXycVvfsM5OfmCxKH2KSdCRB3cxHm3cUF0C-wrGXiOapLtxKgThWT2U434_6ph_l47XivesE_WLrjNuxFc9oJXFInvBU0FCjJXjCaqhQF5JvumVmCwrWQQyZXT61Xi8PQt5PNzyuYCIJ7YzQ_KVNcUrsBetDiwsZOmO7O_XpYRbpJDSunzCmu_U9DcWdzSWOEi5AfZNWTqe11d79ljbVH2-JvfwUX5c2FxgUrlsokKRxX3yh0kdVPFviyWnfIv53UAFzFvONKkXmGK4cixUWXj3nl15xK_HO7BIQiVq3X9Rkw9LSRwz2uRiHqXa7nhe0EbWznqOyZKIhx)" which you can now own on DVD.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=bb78ed1edab644269274a9ca37d2d02f&_e=y__G7Ezo4r8-DNbTiwqTTRMKYg9tefWKLUCbMLnmwFiGTe-9-tambxPeKO_V14QCxCiuuI9eFCiHqTCeasXKcrHuL3FWssG2xHb02Huollmhm_lHv9hpXycVvfsM5OfmCxKH2KSdCRB3cxHm3cUF0C-wrGXiOapLtxKgThWT2U434_6ph_l47XivesE_WLrjNuxFc9oJXFInvBU0FCjJXjCaqhQF5JvumVmCwrWQQyZXT61Xi8PQt5PNzyuYCIJ7NqForZLS5hEbWpMLK9MAH8s6ykPabvaFhLTWfy8s4WMoLa5F2PKMmsAfGLs_YdNoM5pW6aKgDCr5kGVF9bcWcNgsT_QuecHfkeaXPiem1KmcgY_Ydq4EZl1o4dF7UVj-qK93Tg9syCOW-ftvANfkD5SIinPd2sMY7uwdCQ907cQJS4LkEfOsBUkwW3mBE6yr).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

subject: What is Joe Biden Trying to Hide Now?
body:
This is a very serious and urgent matter, so please hear me out. Joe Biden and his administration are stonewalling Judicial Watch over the release of critical public documents directly related to the president's possible criminal liability for the unauthorized removal, retention and disclosure of classified documents after he left office as vice-president in 2017.

| | |
---
|

|

| Dear Fellow American,

This is a very serious and urgent matter, so please hear me out.
Joe Biden and his administration are stonewalling **Judicial Watch** over the release of critical public documents directly related to the president's possible criminal liability for the unauthorized removal, retention and disclosure of classified documents after he left office as vice-president in 2017.
We are fighting back with every legal tool we have...but [**we need your help!**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68232&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68232&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

You may recall, Special Counsel Robert Hur taped recordings of Biden's interviews with prosecutors earlier this year...and later, in his official report, Hur famously called Biden a "well-meaning, elderly man with a poor memory" and declined to charge the president with a "serious felony."

**_Judicial Watch_** _believes the American people have a right to hear these tapes_ , and make up their own minds about Joe Biden's testimony and his credibility....because "no one is above the law," including the President of the United States.

And at **Judicial Watch,** we also believe in _one standard of justice applied to all_!

That's why we sued the Justice Department back in March, after they failed to respond to our Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request for those audio records.

**[And that's why I am asking you to give us your support today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68232&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68232&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Just last week the Justice Department told us that they would not release the two audio tapes because they would constitute a "clearly unwarranted invasion of personal privacy."

I believe that the public's right to know about Joe Biden's actions related to the documents he removed the from the White House outweighs his privacy in this case, _and we will go the legal distance to force the release of records from the Special Counsel's investigation!_

Of course, that costs money.

It's easy to complain about Joe Biden's efforts to hide documents and audio recordings from the American people that "we the people" have a right to see and hear...

_But where others complain,**Judicial Watch** acts_!

[I deeply hope you will help us with a contribution now](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68232&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2), so that we can keep the legal pressure on, in this lawsuit and in all our lawsuits fighting against public corruption and for transparency in government.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68232&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Thank you in advance for giving us your support today!

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton
President

body:
During his time in Congress, Mondaire served on the House Committee on Education and Labor, where he fought tirelessly to improve education across the country.
Happy Teacher Appreciation Week, team!

As a product of public schools in Rockland, Mondaire knows firsthand how important teachers are to a child's success. It was his educators and experience in East Ramapo public schools that motivated him to get involved in politics and allowed a kid who grew up on food stamps and in Section 8 housing to graduate from Harvard Law.

Our teachers play an indispensable role in our children's future. **Yet, far too often, these dedicated professionals don't receive the recognition or compensation they deserve for their vital work.**

One of Mondaire's top priorities has always been fighting for our teachers and public schools. That's why during his time in Congress, Mondaire proudly served on the House Committee on Education and Labor, where he successfully fought to increase educational funding across the country.

**Mondaire is committed to continuing that fight when he returns to Congress, ensuring that our educators and public schools receive the support they need to thrive.** **[If you agree that we need to clean_body: During his time in Congress, Mondaire served on the House Committee on Education and Labor, where he fought tirelessly to improve education across the country. Happy Teacher Appreciation Week, team! As a product of public schools in Rockland, Mondaire knows firsthand how important teachers are to a child's success. It was his educators and experience in East Ramapo public schools that motivated him to get involved in politics and allowed a kid who grew up on food stamps and in Section 8 housing to graduate from Harvard Law. Our teachers play an indispensable role in our children's future. Yet, far too often, these dedicated professionals don't receive the recognition or compensation they deserve for their vital work. One of Mondaire's top priorities has always been fighting for our teachers and public schools. That's why during his time in Congress, Mondaire proudly served on the House Committee on Education and Labor, where he successfully fought to increase educational funding across the country. Mondaire is committed to continuing that fight when he returns to Congress, ensuring that our educators and public schools receive the support they need to thrive. Thank you, Team Mondaire | Mondaire Jones is running for Congress to finish the work he started last term. He's ready to fight to lower costs for residents of the Hudson Valley, defend our democracy, raise wages, and protect reproductive rights for all. name: Eric Hansen, candidate for U.S. Senate
subject: Save Money. Live Better.
body:
It's not just slogan... | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f700b7658c37/im-running-for-us-senate-14179117?e=dbd1068b05)
---
Hi there - It’s Eric.
To me, “**Save Money. Live Better.** ” is so much more than just a company slogan. It’s how I plan to serve Delaware in the United State Senate.
Let me explain.
I spent the bulk of my career in the private sector at Walmart, and I’m proud of my time there. **My team and I saved the American people $25 billion because of our commitment to offer consumers everyday household items at lower prices. We never lost sight of that goal: Cut prices on things people need so they can live better lives.**
It was a simple idea, but it also took a lot of hard work, problem-solving, and collaboration. We could not have done it without the help and support of others.That’s the mentality I’ll take with me to Washington.
My goal is to help every Delawarean live a better life. It doesn't matter how old you are, where you come from, or what political party you align with. I want to help improve lives. More often than not, that means streamlining government and cutting wasteful spending so we can put money BACK in the hands of the people.
[Donate to Change Delaware! ](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=6b5d374ce1&e=dbd1068b05)
The reality is that career politicians just don’t get it. You can’t expect the people that created the problems to fix the problems. It’s going to take an outsider with private-sector experience to straighten out the mess in Washington DC. I know I’m up for that task, but I need your help to get there.
[**Will you take a leap of faith and send a political outsider to the U.S. Senate this November? I could really use your help and support.**](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=b63b4066a1&e=dbd1068b05)
Thank you!

| Peter –

Zach and I had two very different experiences in higher education. When I was at Harvard, politics was rarely discussed in the vitriolic nature as it is today. clean_body: | | | | | | | | | Peter – This week, I continued to speak out against the antisemitic and often violent protests on college campuses. These protests are evidence of rising radicalism in higher education that we've seen in recent years, radicalism that must be rooted out in these institutions. I also highlighted a ridiculous proposal to expand Obamacare to cover illegal immigrants. I am grateful for the support of committed patriots like you who make this newsletter, and my re-election campaign, possible. I hope you find these briefs informative and I greatly appreciate your continued support of my campaign. We saw more chaos in the House of Representatives this week, as an attempt failed to oust Speaker Johnson. I voted against the motion to vacate, as it was yet another performative maneuver by attention seekers who want nothing more than to fundraise and gain fame for themselves. This is why it is so important that we elect serious, conservative leaders to the House this fall - building our majority with people who actually want to make law and advance the conservative agenda when they're elected. That is what I'm going to be focused on from now until November, making sure we grow our Republican majority with effective conservatives who will move the ball forward on conservative policies instead of relish in performance politics. When you donate to my campaign, you're supporting that mission and I'd humbly ask that you donate today. Any amount helps: | | | == | Now, here's your brief. | | | | | | | | RISING RADICALISM IN HIGHER EDUCATION | | | == | | | == | To understand the rising radicalism in higher education, it's helpful to talk to those with the most intimate experience in these settings: recent graduates of elite colleges. That's exactly what I did this week. I sat down with Zach Kessel, a recent graduate of Northwestern University and current Buckley Fellow at National Review. Zach and I had two very different experiences in higher education. When I was at Harvard, politics was rarely discussed in the vitriolic nature as it is today. You didn't wear your political affiliation on your sleeve, and students did not hold animosity toward one another because of their politics. Compare that to today, and Zach's experience at Northwestern, and the differences are quite concerning. Political vitriol is not only ubiquitous on college campuses - especially elite universities - but it has devolved into the most base kind of identity politics. Zach shares anecdotes of his orientation, when students were asked to stand up if they belonged to so-called "protected political classes" \- black, gay, etc. It is a revealing podcast, and helpful to understand the current environment on college campuses where pro-Hamas protests have taken hold of these universities. You can listen to our full conversation at the link above and read Zach's thoughtful pieces at National Review here: == | | | | | | | | WHERE ARE THE ADULTS? | == | == | | | The through-line for much of these pro-Hamas protests at elite universities is administrators and professors capitulating to the mob. At Zach's alma mater, Northwestern, the school's leaders bowed to the demands of the protestors, establishing a committee to further the BDS movement and even committing to building Muslim-specific housing for students and raise money for Palestinian scholarships. It begs the question: where are the adults? It's important to remember that these are college students. Some of them just graduated high school. They know next to nothing about the world or the conflict they are currently protesting. These unhinged protests - about a topic that is brand new to most of these young social justice warriors - is a consequence of years of coddling by university administrators and professors. They let the inmates run the asylum for too long. It's time to restore discipline, focus on education, and actually learn something in the classroom. | | | | | | | | OBAMACARE FOR ILLEGAL IMMIGRANTS? YES, JOE BIDEN IS PROPOSING THAT | == | == | Joe Biden is out with another brilliant idea to incentivize illegal immigrants to come to America. This time, it's with the promise of a taxpayer subsidized healthcare program - Obamacare. You'll recall that Joe Biden promised during the 2020 Democrat presidential primary that he would provide healthcare for illegal immigrants as president. Now, he's making good on that nonsensical promise. The Biden Administration is rolling out a rule that would allow nearly 100,000 illegal immigrants access to the Obamacare marketplace. What's worse, they are justifying this by making Health and Human Services modify the definition of "lawfully present" to determine eligibility. This is the problem with government programs. Not only do they fall victim to fraud, waste, and abuse -- they become a handout for politicians to buy support. All because Biden uses the administrative state to bend the definition of "lawfully present." I have cosponsored a bill to block states from enrolling illegal immigrants in Medicaid. We have to do the same for this new interpretation of Obamacare. | | | | | | | | == | ENDEX - my new campaign merch store - is launching very soon. The ENDEX Concealed Carry Pants and Shorts feature the removable Holster system, giving you a concealed carry holster flawlessly integrated with stylish everyday wear pants. Made from performance stretch twill that moves with you, and featuring moisture-wicking and water-resistant properties, these pants are crafted for the ultimate in everyday use, from the golf course to the gun range. The patented Holster belt features 5 holster positions for compact pistols, 6 magazine holsters, and it can be reversed easily for left-handed shooters. He also knows that America’s success, and our leadership role in the world, are on the line with the way President Biden and his Democrat allies are running things in Washington. Radical leftists believe the idea of American exceptionalism is flawed, and our country is in need of fundamental, moral repair. Nothing could be further from the truth. I’m standing with Kevin Coughlin because he knows what we are up against, and he has the courage to not back down when the Democrat smears against him and his family get going. Friend --
#### **Tonight's Sare Symposium \--****A Beethoven Anniversary discussion **
May 8th was the 200th anniversary of the birth of Beethoven’s unique, relentlessly optimistic _Ninth Symphony_ , the “Choral” Symphony based upon Friedrich Schiller’s revolutionary poem, _An die Freude_ (_Ode to Joy_). The co-founder and conductor of the only joint Israeli-Palestinian orchestra, Daniel Barenboim, celebrated the birth of the Ninth by posing Beethoven’s genius: “The greatness of music, and the _Ninth Symphony_ , lies in the richness of its contrasts. Music never just laughs or cries; it always laughs and cries at the same time. Creating unity out of contradictions—that is Beethoven for me. Music, if you study it properly, is a lesson for life. There is much we can learn from Beethoven. He is the master of bringing emotion and intellect together. With Beethoven, you must be able to structure your feelings and feel the structure emotionally—a fantastic lesson for life!” Join us tonight, Friday May 10, at 7 pm, for a Sare New York Symposium entitled "**How Can** t**he Sorrows of the Current World Coexist with the Joy of an Emerging New Paradigm"? How do we think like Beethoven?**

I'll lean on a pot of coffee and work late into the night if I have to to make sure all my I's are dotted and my T's are crossed.

But, sometimes, I like to do a little background research on the witnesses that my colleagues invite to testify.

This comes in handy when someone who is telling you to 'End Climate Change' has also called for 'Abolishing the Police'.

Context matters, folks.
_You see_ , the goat-milk latte crowd will follow the calling of the masses through every single warped, misleading idea any of them have.

He wants us to get rid of CO2, but he couldn't tell me much about what CO2 even is.

body:
More than 100 mid-Michigan veterans announce their support | | | [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=663e37a4ab3be57c05289acc&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftombarrettforcongress.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D663e1e0bb46ea16167cd8f4d%26ss_email_id%3D663e37a4ab3be57c05289acc%26ss_campaign_name%3DMichigan%2BVeterans%2BUnited%2BBehind%2BTom%2BBarrett%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-05-10T15%253A07%253A43Z&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_663e1e0bb46ea16167cd8f4d&l=en-US&s=kHHW3rtFwvzzMjqg1BahmE83aKA%3D)
---
| **Michigan Veterans Unite Behind Tom Barrett**
---
(Lansing, Mich.) – Today, 22-year U.S. Army veteran and congressional candidate Tom Barrett announced the launch of the Veterans For Barrett coalition with over 100 veterans from across Mid-Michigan coming together in support of his candidacy.“Tom’s exemplary service to our country and our state makes him the most qualified candidate to serve as the next congressman for the 7th District. Congress has seen a decrease in its members who are veterans, and we need more representation in Washington. I’m proud to endorse Tom and serve as the Chair of Veterans For Barrett because I know Tom will continue to vigorously fight for veterans, their families, and our military in Congress, just as he did during his time in the Michigan Legislature,” said Bobby Bright. Brite served 26 years in the Army and is an Iraq War veteran, where he earned the Bronze Star and the Combat Infantryman Badge. He is also the past Commander of American Legion Post 141 in Howell, one of Michigan's top-performing posts.
---
| [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=663e37a4ab3be57c05289acc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fvets-for-barrett&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_663e1e0bb46ea16167cd8f4d&l=en-US&s=4B_aAX3cimKqJKMXUQjNboTkz4o%3D)
---
| _[Click here to watch a video message from Tom.](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=663e37a4ab3be57c05289acc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fvets-for-barrett&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_663e1e0bb46ea16167cd8f4d&l=en-US&s=4B_aAX3cimKqJKMXUQjNboTkz4o%3D)_
---
“I was elected to the Michigan legislature 10 years ago as the only Iraq War Veteran in the entire House of Representatives, and as a freshman lawmaker one of my proudest achievements was leading the legislative effort to address the chronic abuse, neglect, and coverup at the Grand Rapids Home for Veterans. I will take this same fire in my belly to Washington as a voice for veterans, so they receive the care, resources, and respect that they have earned through their sacrifice and service to our country.
