name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Re: Louis DeJoy and the USPS
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| Louis DeJoy has done everything he can to make the USPS more expensive and less convenient to use.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2583%2E35263%2EhL1ORl)
Peter — Across Wisconsin, I hear people express their concerns about the USPS and the future of our postal service while Louis DeJoy remains Postmaster General. Ever since Donald Trump appointed him in 2020, Louis DeJoy has done everything he can to make the USPS more expensive and less convenient to use. _It’s a shame._ DeJoy enacted massive cuts to postal services, decommissioned mail-sorting machines, and slowed down mail delivery in the months leading up to the 2020 election — when millions of Americans were counting on voting by mail. A federal judge even ruled that DeJoy’s harmful policies right before those elections harmed delivery. The USPS is a vital service that millions of Americans count on for access to medicine, paychecks, ballots, and so much more — which is why I prioritized passing legislation to improve the USPS. But it’s clear that only new leadership will be enough to overcome Louis DeJoy’s crusade against the critical services the USPS provides. **Enough is enough — it’s time for Louis DeJoy to be removed as Postmaster General before he degrades the USPS any further.** **[If you agree, add your name today to my petition calling on the USPS Board of Governors to remove DeJoy from office as soon as possible:](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/signup/2405_USPS_petition/?refcode=AU_STB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240510_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2583%2E35263%2EhL1ORl)** | | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/signup/2405_USPS_petition/?refcode=AU_STB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240510_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=2583%2E35263%2EhL1ORl)

— Tammy

name: David
subject: The People’s Congress: From Cryptocurrency to Census Changes
body:
Dysfunction and special interest meddling once again ran rampant through the halls of Congress. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/davidkimforca/the-peoples-congress-from-cryptocurrency-to-census-changes?e=fee98d637f)
---
| |
---
| | | **Dear Friends,

Dysfunction and special interest meddling once again ran rampant through the halls of Congress. As we wrap up another week in The People’s Congress, let's break down what happened and how it will impact our community. From cryptocurrency to a motion to oust the Speaker of the House, here’s a look into what happened in Congress this week.**
---
| _**This Week's Legislative Overview:**_
---
| _**Cryptocurrency Regulation (H.J.Res. 109):**_
This resolution, which passed the House on Tuesday, **(228 YAYS, 182 NAYS)** overturns a Securities and Exchange Commission rule regarding the regulation of cryptocurrencies.

I would have voted against the passage of this resolution. Cryptocurrencies, while innovative, are complex and confusing— and not just for the public. This complexity can make it tough for Congress to develop effective regulations. As your future representative, I’ll be guided by my commitment to protect the financial well-being and investments of working families and everyday consumers, regardless of the currency involved.
---
|
---
| _**Census Representation (H.R. 7109 - Equal Representation Act):**_
In a move I __firmly oppose__ , Congress passed a bill **(206 YAYS, 202 NAYS, 22 Not Voting)** which seeks to alter how congressional districts are apportioned by excluding undocumented immigrants from Census counts.

I would have voted NO on this bill. In the 250 year history of the census, no one has ever been excluded because of immigration status. This measure, which is specifically designed to diminish Congressional representation from states with larger undocumented populations like California, is a Republican power grab that fundamentally undermines our democracy.. Every individual, regardless of their immigration status, contributes to our communities and our economy, and thus deserves representation. Our policies must reflect our commitment to inclusivity and fairness, ensuring that all voices are heard and valued in our democratic process.
---
|
---
| _**Energy and Environmental Concerns (H.R. 6192 - Hands Off Our Home Appliances Act):**_
This week, Congress narrowly passed a bill **(212 YAYS, 195 NAYS)** that restricts the Department of Energy’s ability to require new appliances to be more energy-efficient. While it's important to avoid imposing undue financial burdens on consumers, this decision overlooks the crucial role of energy efficiency in combating climate change, and, in the long run, strengthening the economy.

I would have voted against this bill. I believe that true economic justice is inseparable from environmental sustainability, and that we protect our future by passing legislation that makes our economy and our planet healthier.
---
|
---
| _**Mining and Environmental Impact (H.R. 2925 - Mining Regulatory Clarity Act of 2024):**_
The recent passage **(216 YAYS, 195 NAYS)** of this bill allows for more unrestricted mining operations on public lands, raising serious environmental concerns. As an advocate for sustainable development, I strongly believe that our industrial advancements must not compromise our environmental integrity.
**I would have voted NO on this bill.** I believe that every legislative decision should contribute to our fight against climate change, not exacerbate it. As your future representative, I will promote policies that ensure our economic actions are in harmony with our crucial environmental responsibilities.
---
|
---
| _**Congressional Side Note:**_
After a failed attempt to remove Speaker Mike Johnson on Tuesday, tensions are at an all time high in Congress. With Congress in disarray, it's everyday people who will suffer because of this dysfunction. It is clear that strategic and thoughtful legislation is more crucial than ever. However, with the election fast approaching, it is unclear how productive Congress will be before the lame-duck session.
---
| | **What is a lame-duck session?

A lame-duck session occurs after an election but before new officials take office, typically at the year's end. For the U.S. Congress, this session starts after November elections and continues until the new Congress is sworn in on January 3rd. Outgoing legislators still serve but with reduced influence, as they are on their way out. During this period, Congress may hurry to complete pending tasks or pass crucial legislation, though its effectiveness can be unpredictable due to the upcoming change in membership and leadership.**
---
|
---
| _**Engage and Reflect:**_
Don’t sit this one out! If any of these bills don’t sit right with you, now's your moment to act. Remember, a bill must clear both the House and Senate, and receive the President's signature to become law. Make your voice heard and contact your Senators today—your influence can shape the outcome before it's too late.

Need help finding your Representative’s and/or Senator’s contact information? Find it [HERE](https://davidkimforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c05fe848bb5af5e7b9d690b2f&id=b13f4d77fa&e=fee98d637f).

Thank you for your continued support and commitment to our community. Together, we are making a difference.

Warm regards,

David Kim
Candidate for Congress, CA-34

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

FIRST: NPR and KFF Health News reported that over 100 million Americans carry health care debt.

THEN: Senator Bernie Sanders and I introduced the Medical Debt Cancellation Act, a bill that would cancel all existing medical debt, wipe medical debt from all credit reports, and limit the accrual of future medical debt.

NOW: I’m being attacked by Big Pharma, predatory debt purchasers, and hospitals profiting from the financial suffering of millions of patients.

Before I explain, will you rush a $3 contribution to my campaign to let me know you have my back and keep fighting for an end to medical debt? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/medical-debt-fundraiser?amount=3]

DONATE $3 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/medical-debt-fundraiser?amount=3]

Healthcare is a right, not a privilege. In the world’s wealthiest country, there is no reason people should carry medical debt and face financial ruin just for getting sick or injured.

Now critics are lambasting me with the rhetorical question: “But how will you pay for it?

EASY: RIP Medical Debt has proven that we can wipe out debt for pennies on the dollar. In New York City, they canceled [https://www.nyc.gov/content/getstuffdone/pages/canceling-medical-debt-for-new-yorkers] $2 billion of debt for $18 million.

At that rate, it would cost the United States about $1.75 billion to cancel medical debt.

To put that number into context, the top five most profitable healthcare companies had a gross revenue [https://www.valuepenguin.com/largest-health-insurance-companies] of $623 billion in 2023. That’s about 0.25% of their gross revenue for a single year. So don’t tell me we can’t afford it.

I won’t let Big Pharma and others profit from medical debt, but I need to know that you have my back. Will you rush a contribution to my campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/medical-debt-fundraiser]

Thank you for your activism and your support.

In solidarity,
Ro

| | 1\. Voter Registration: OpportunitiesTo Change The Future
---
| | Great job to all who are putting in the effort for new voter registration—it's really making a difference! In Central and Eastern Washington, the number of newly registered voters in 2024 could make up 2-5% of the total voter turnout, possibly even reaching 12% when combined with 2023 registrations. Given the struggles with Democratic voting numbers, this new voter base is incredibly important.
---
| |
---
| | However, reaching these voters poses challenges. Despite the efforts of organizations focused on voter education and outreach, many newly registered voters slip away or become targets for the far-right. To tackle this issue, Rural Americans United has launched the "Second Touch" program. This initiative involves following up with newly registered voters to provide them with information about Democrats in Central and Eastern Washington and counter the influence of MAGA rhetoric. With an election year underway, it's crucial that these voters hear democratic messages, especially as they're likely to receive other messages from our candidates.

| | 2\. The Washington State GOP Declares War On Democracy
---
| | The Washington State GOP has declared war on democracy. A recent article in the [Seattle Times](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/44OzY-JLQ/c?w=BKvL-wY0g2odlaJUibTzOsGDrygUoBUq3ma3D58KM4o.) covering the Washington State GOP convention highlighted some troubling concerns which were further discussed on Rachel Maddow. The [GOP platform](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/44OzY-JLQ/c?w=g_s5pbiMmXuemvxxzeGUkkuYtXpGTOWidjc-N8kDsZU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZG9jdW1lbnRjbG91ZC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzLzI0NjAyMzQ4LTIwMjQtZ29wLXJlc29sdXRpb25zIiwiciI6IjJjOTA1Mzc1LTg5MjAtNGFmYi1hMTljLTEyODg5YTA4ODY0ZiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) has shifted away from democracy, aiming to establish an absolute republic where Republican ideals and Republicanism would replace democratic values.
---
| | Rachel Maddow TikTok click image to watch
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/44OzY-JLQ/c?w=IethpOok3heKMmj96av2j6XLI1PYYXvbi3rYgVCmitw.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGlrdG9rLmNvbS90L1pUTFhOOXBLNS8iLCJyIjoiZDIxZjEwNjktZTVlYy00MGE2LTgxNzAtMDBlMDkzZGU4NzI2IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)
---
| | Some may argue that we are already a republic, questioning why this distinction is important. However, it's crucial because it reveals the direction the Republican Party, now being influenced by MAGA and Trump, wants to take the country. A republic is a nation of laws written by representatives of the people, which sounds good in theory, ensuring equal treatment under the law. But this only holds true if those making the laws are impartial, and we know that's not always the case. Maintaining the democratic aspect of our government is critical to prevent those in power from becoming tyrants. There is ample evidence that our government's structure has the potential to concentrate power, through legislator power, gerrymandering, voter suppression, passing self-serving laws, and more. These are implicit or explicit goals of MAGA's Project 2025, as stated by party members, including Trump. Moving from democracy to a republic is not just about our form of government; it's about aligning the United States with MAGA ideology. By reinforcing the US as a republic, it makes the move to authoritarian rule seem inevitable. Education is powerful. Long-term education campaigns have influenced behaviors such as wearing seat belts and quitting smoking, and in rural America, they've embraced MAGA ideology. Education can also be the most effective tool in restoring democratic values and sensibilities in rural America. Rural Americans United is transitioning our successful pro-democratic values radio messaging campaign into a groundbreaking initiative in Central and Eastern Washington. This scientific approach engages low voter turnout populations through micro-dialogues to understand their interests and motivations. It's a departure from traditional polling methods, and we have high expectations for significant results.

| | 5\. Dominick Bonny: Christian Nationalism And Their Call To Violence
---
| | A charismatic Christian group fixated on the end times called The Collective kicked off a four-week survival and "Kingdom Defense" workshop series in Chelan County this past weekend, and in it attendees will receive beginning and intermediate firearms training, learn the basics of battlefield medicine and food prepping for disaster scenarios, among other skills. This Collective is affiliated with an organization out of Portland, Oregon and the leader is a woman named Jenny Donnelly. She and her husband Bob have a vision to take back America and dominate the "seven mountains of influence" thus ushering in the second coming of Jesus Christ. They held rallies at the state capitals across the country earlier this month and they're not done yet. You can read more about The Collective, The Donnellys and what we can expect from Christian Nationalists this year from investigative reporter Dominick Bonny [here](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/44OzY-JLQ/c?w=Yxgq4VKHoDrVH8_S29lWYCZCpBUDAKW8e7b7pxZEt_c.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iaXQubHkvM1Vmd041diIsInIiOiI4ZGExM2M2NC01OWY1LTQ4ODMtODRhOC1hNTJlMTU4MjExYTYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ): [https://bit.ly/3UfwN5v](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/44OzY-JLQ/c?w=Yxgq4VKHoDrVH8_S29lWYCZCpBUDAKW8e7b7pxZEt_c.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iaXQubHkvM1Vmd041diIsInIiOiI4ZGExM2M2NC01OWY1LTQ4ODMtODRhOC1hNTJlMTU4MjExYTYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ)

Voter Registration: Opportunities To Change The Future 2. The Washington State GOP Declares War On Democracy 3. Snazzy Swag For Our Super Supporters 4. The Community Turns Out and Shows Up 5. PCO Please: Register by May 10th In the next newsletter: More data to drive smart election decisions, Rural Americans United project updates, Candidates page on Rural Americans United's Website released and more | | | | | 1\. Voter Registration: OpportunitiesTo Change The Future | | Great job to all who are putting in the effort for new voter registration—it's really making a difference! In Central and Eastern Washington, the number of newly registered voters in 2024 could make up 2-5% of the total voter turnout, possibly even reaching 12% when combined with 2023 registrations. Given the struggles with Democratic voting numbers, this new voter base is incredibly important. | | | | However, reaching these voters poses challenges. Despite the efforts of organizations focused on voter education and outreach, many newly registered voters slip away or become targets for the far-right. To tackle this issue, Rural Americans United has launched the "Second Touch" program. This initiative involves following up with newly registered voters to provide them with information about Democrats in Central and Eastern Washington and counter the influence of MAGA rhetoric. With an election year underway, it's crucial that these voters hear democratic messages, especially as they're likely to receive other messages from our candidates. | | | | Data provided by Washington State. Asotin, Lincoln and Spokane counties data is missing along with Yakima county's March 2024 voter registration data. | | We've been reaching out to local organizations in Central and Eastern Washington to support voter outreach efforts. Some counties lack the resources needed to carry out these efforts effectively. Rural Americans United is stepping in where we can to fill this gap and ensure that voters have access to the information they need. If you wish to help out please contact us for more information. | | | | | 2\. The Washington State GOP Declares War On Democracy | | The Washington State GOP has declared war on democracy. A recent article in the covering the Washington State GOP convention highlighted some troubling concerns which were further discussed on Rachel Maddow. The has shifted away from democracy, aiming to establish an absolute republic where Republican ideals and Republicanism would replace democratic values. | | Rachel Maddow TikTok click image to watch | | | | Some may argue that we are already a republic, questioning why this distinction is important. However, it's crucial because it reveals the direction the Republican Party, now being influenced by MAGA and Trump, wants to take the country. A republic is a nation of laws written by representatives of the people, which sounds good in theory, ensuring equal treatment under the law. But this only holds true if those making the laws are impartial, and we know that's not always the case. Maintaining the democratic aspect of our government is critical to prevent those in power from becoming tyrants. There is ample evidence that our government's structure has the potential to concentrate power, through legislator power, gerrymandering, voter suppression, passing self-serving laws, and more. These are implicit or explicit goals of MAGA's Project 2025, as stated by party members, including Trump. Moving from democracy to a republic is not just about our form of government; it's about aligning the United States with MAGA ideology. By reinforcing the US as a republic, it makes the move to authoritarian rule seem inevitable. Education is powerful. Long-term education campaigns have influenced behaviors such as wearing seat belts and quitting smoking, and in rural America, they've embraced MAGA ideology. Education can also be the most effective tool in restoring democratic values and sensibilities in rural America. Rural Americans United is transitioning our successful pro-democratic values radio messaging campaign into a groundbreaking initiative in Central and Eastern Washington. This scientific approach engages low voter turnout populations through micro-dialogues to understand their interests and motivations. It's a departure from traditional polling methods, and we have high expectations for significant results. | | | | | 3\. Snazzy Swag For OurSuper Supporters | | In February, we reached over 100 recurring donors, which allowed us to expand our programs. Now, our goal is to reach 150 recurring donations by the end of May! If our purpose and performance aren't convincing enough, here's some snazzy swag. | | | | | | | 4\. Community Turns Out And Shows Up | | We celebrate many cultures in Central and Eastern Washington. This month we pay special tribute to Asian American and Native Hawaiian/ Pacific Islanders Heritage Month and Latino communities. | | | | Check out these Facebook Groups: and for events in your area. Cinco de Mayo in Pasco was huge. The festival almost did not happen due to financial problems of the organizing group, but local community members came together and fun was had by all. We all have the spirit to make life better. | | | | | 5\. Dominick Bonny: Christian Nationalism And Their Call To Violence | | A charismatic Christian group fixated on the end times called The Collective kicked off a four-week survival and "Kingdom Defense" workshop series in Chelan County this past weekend, and in it attendees will receive beginning and intermediate firearms training, learn the basics of battlefield medicine and food prepping for disaster scenarios, among other skills. This Collective is affiliated with an organization out of Portland, Oregon and the leader is a woman named Jenny Donnelly. She and her husband Bob have a vision to take back America and dominate the "seven mountains of influence" thus ushering in the second coming of Jesus Christ. They held rallies at the state capitals across the country earlier this month and they're not done yet. You can read more about The Collective, The Donnellys and what we can expect from Christian Nationalists this year from investigative reporter Dominick Bonny : | | | | | 6\. PCO Please! | | The Democrat party needs Precinct Committee Officers. They are the backbone of all that happens. Think of it as being the eyes and ears of your neighborhood. This is an elected position. Your name will be on the ballot! It costs nothing and you do not need to know your precinct. Just go to the site below before 4pm on Friday May 10th and follow the simple instructions. All you need to know is your name, date of birth, address, the position is precinct and that you are a Democrat. name: Jill Stein
subject: Did you miss my urgent message?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
This is the most critical moment of our campaign.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=clone_of_jill_ny_appeal&n=1)
---
Peter, **I sent an urgent email earlier this week and wanted to make sure you didn't miss it. Right now is probably the most critical moment of our campaign. We need all hands on deck to get on the ballot in New York. **As you may know, shortly after taking full control of NY state government Andrew Cuomo and the NY Democrats tripled the ballot access requirement to 45,000 signatures in a 6-week period, making NY arguably the most difficult state to get on the ballot. Over halfway through the petitioning period, we are behind where we need to be. With just two and a half weeks to clear this hurdle by the May 28th deadline, we need everyone to do what they can to help _now_. **Our most critical need right now is for people to collect signatures in New York.** We are looking for volunteers as well as people who would like to get paid to petition. **If you can come petition in New York, we need your help!** Let us know if you’re willing to help collect signatures in NY and we’ll get in touch to make arrangements for your visit, including accommodations if you need them. We're also looking for folks in NY or nearby who can provide housing or transportation for petitioners.******However you can help, please sign up now:**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=clone_of_jill_ny_appeal&n=2 "HELP JILL GET ON THE NY BALLOT") [HELP JILL GET ON THE NY BALLOT](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=clone_of_jill_ny_appeal&n=2)
---
**We also need everyone to donate whatever they can to help us fund this urgent ballot drive.** Every dollar you can donate helps move us closer to the all-important goal of getting 45,000 valid signatures in New York. **Please pitch in as much as you can now to help make it happen!**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donation_ny?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=clone_of_jill_ny_appeal&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donation_ny?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=clone_of_jill_ny_appeal&n=3)
---
**Our campaign is finally starting to break through after months of hard work.** A recent CBS poll from Wisconsin had us at 8% in a 3-way race, including 22% among voters 18-30 and 16% among voters 30-44. Since I was arrested with my campaign manager and deputy campaign manager last week in St. Louis, we’ve had a flood of media inquiries and back-to-back interviews with major media outlets. We got a big endorsement from world-renowned Columbia University Professor Jeffrey Sachs, and we’ve raised over $100,000 just in the last week. **People seem to be waking up to the fact that ours is the one anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action campaign with a real shot of being on the ballot in every state this November.** **But it all depends on what happens in the next two and a half weeks in New York.** If we hit our goal in New York, we’re well on the way to nationwide ballot access - which would make us the first Green presidential campaign to achieve this milestone. With multiple systemic crises hitting at the same time and rejection of the establishment candidates at a record high, the sky is the limit for what lies ahead in this race - including a real shot at the White House. But if we miss the ballot in New York, it would be a major blow to this campaign and to our hopes of building the new major party we so badly need. **This is a do-or-die moment, and we need you to rise to the challenge.** I was in New York on day one to help launch the ballot drive, and I'm returning there today to rally support to get our campaign and the Green Party back on the ballot. I hope you will join me - or support us however you can. Right now, New York is the best hope the parties of war and Wall Street have to trip us up and smother the momentum we are building every day. sights on Reps. Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush.

unseat the Squad from Congress, and they planned to spend $100 million to
do it.

since progressive champion Summer Lee handily defeated her GOP
billionaire-backed opponent in April’s primary. AIPAC didn’t even bother
spending in her race despite attacking her for her pro-ceasefire stance
last fall, because they could see the power of our grassroots movement
standing with her.

Bowman’s highly contested primary in NY-16, which is shaping up to be the
most expensive House primary race in history and the most competitive
Democratic primary this cycle.

There, AIPAC has already pumped $1.2 million into the conservative
challenger’s campaign, and they’re getting ready to drop up to $25 million
in attack ads against Jamaal any day now.

# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _Congratulations Primary Winners!_**
---
Friends, We at the Indiana GOP would like to congratulate all of our primary winners and thank everyone who participated this primary season. It has been a long journey, and we now have our candidates for the 2024 elections. We are excited to get behind our nominees and join in the fight ensuring we have victories all across the state in November. We look forward to working with candidates up and down the ballot to have a strong 2024. We would like to especially congratulate our candidates who will be running statewide this November and leading our party at the top of the ticket, Donald Trump, Mike Braun and Jim Banks. We look forward to working with these campaigns to unite all Republicans and keep these seats red. As we rally together to support all of our nominees, it is important to remember that regardless of which race you are working on, this November is about a clear choice. The Democrat Party led by Joe Biden has led to lawlessness, a humanitarian crisis at our southern border, crippling inflation, and a weak America abroad. It is time for us to come together to support our Republican candidates who will always put America and Indiana first. Thank you for your continued support and for all that you do.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway
---

Holcomb said. “The results from the voluntary employee survey reinforces the state’s commitment to providing staff with a competitive compensation and benefits package and a flexible work-life balance.” \- **Gov. I’m a proud son of the Delta, and I’m running to become Mississippi’s next U.S. Senator

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84701916/472357352/1023996456?refcode=RE_EM_FR_240510_GKM_R_2_logo&amount=50&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWNiODU0MDktZWYwZS1lZjExLTk2ZjMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0YEua93dcNevorOO8X-uDL5KjP2aUuG0HIFJCbeiOk4=)
Hi Peter,

If you don’t know me, my name is Ty Pinkins. I’m the proud son of a tractor driver, born and raised in Rolling Fork. I am a Bronze Star Veteran, an attorney, and a community organizer. I’m also the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate in our great state of Mississippi.

[If you already know about me and you’re ready to join the team, you can support our campaign for a better Mississippi here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84701917/472357353/1023996456?refcode=RE_EM_FR_240510_GKM_R_2_l1&amount=50&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWNiODU0MDktZWYwZS1lZjExLTk2ZjMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0YEua93dcNevorOO8X-uDL5KjP2aUuG0HIFJCbeiOk4=)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84701918/472357354/1023996456?refcode=RE_EM_FR_240510_GKM_R_2_G1&amount=50&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWNiODU0MDktZWYwZS1lZjExLTk2ZjMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0YEua93dcNevorOO8X-uDL5KjP2aUuG0HIFJCbeiOk4=)
I’m a Mississippian, through and through. Moving from farm to farm, depending on where my dad found work, both of my parents taught me the value of hard work from a young age.

My parents lived the values that I abide by now - service to others, listening to folks about what matters to them, and taking action to help them.

_Thanks to their example, I became the first person in my family to graduate high school and attend college._

Growing up in the Delta, I knew that I wanted to be of service to my community. The first opportunity I saw was enlisting in the U.S. Army. I served 21 years on active duty, including three combat tours. I was awarded the Bronze Star for my actions. I studied on bases around the world and ultimately completed my undergraduate degree while stationed in Okinawa, Japan.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84701919/472357355/1023996456?refcode=RE_EM_FR_240510_GKM_R_2_G2&amount=50&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWNiODU0MDktZWYwZS1lZjExLTk2ZjMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0YEua93dcNevorOO8X-uDL5KjP2aUuG0HIFJCbeiOk4=)
**But I was just getting started.**

After coming home, I knew that I needed to continue my service in the Delta. There are too many injustices and inequalities facing all of our families. Many of our friends and our neighbors are staring down poverty, underfunded schools, lack of quality healthcare, and high unemployment. So I founded a nonprofit where we work to serve and inspire youth from low-income communities, provide career and academic-related resources and the opportunity to work with mentors.

Yet, there was still more I could do for my community. So I went to law school and instead of pursuing some far-off lucrative career, I came right back to Mississippi.

As an attorney I fought back against landlords trying to force evictions on parents during the COVID-19 crisis, represented workers seeking compensation in the face of unfair employment practices, and low-income Mississippians just trying to get a fair shake in our justice system.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84701920/472357356/1023996456?refcode=RE_EM_FR_240510_GKM_R_2_G3&amount=50&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWNiODU0MDktZWYwZS1lZjExLTk2ZjMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0YEua93dcNevorOO8X-uDL5KjP2aUuG0HIFJCbeiOk4=)
In our communities, I’ve been an advocate for improving our elections by helping to establish organizations supporting women seeking elected office, helping draw fair voting districts to make our democracy fair for all of us, and expanding voting rights to make it easier to access the ballot. As I work alongside other Mississippians, I’m always asking myself “What more can I do for others?”

One thing has remained constant – my parents’ lived example of the importance of giving back and using what you have to help others. [So now, I’m continuing my service to Mississippi by running for the U.S. Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84701925/472357357/1023996456?refcode=RE_EM_FR_240510_GKM_R_2_l2&amount=50&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWNiODU0MDktZWYwZS1lZjExLTk2ZjMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0YEua93dcNevorOO8X-uDL5KjP2aUuG0HIFJCbeiOk4=)

I believe the most important thing a leader must do is listen. And, this is the big thing that is missing in Washington today. That's why our campaign motto is _“You Talk. I Listen. We Do.”_ This means our campaign is driven by you talking, telling me what's important to you and your family; me listening, waking up each day thinking about what you say is important to your family and your community; and you and I working together to move Mississippi forward.

clean_body: I’m a proud son of the Delta, and I’m running to become Mississippi’s next U.S. Senator = Hi Peter, If you don’t know me, my name is Ty Pinkins. I’m the proud son of a tractor driver, born and raised in Rolling Fork. I am a Bronze Star Veteran, an attorney, and a community organizer. I’m also the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate in our great state of Mississippi. = = I’m a Mississippian, through and through. Moving from farm to farm, depending on where my dad found work, both of my parents taught me the value of hard work from a young age. My parents lived the values that I abide by now - service to others, listening to folks about what matters to them, and taking action to help them. Thanks to their example, I became the first person in my family to graduate high school and attend college. Growing up in the Delta, I knew that I wanted to be of service to my community. The first opportunity I saw was enlisting in the U.S. Army. I served 21 years on active duty, including three combat tours. I was awarded the Bronze Star for my actions. I studied on bases around the world and ultimately completed my undergraduate degree while stationed in Okinawa, Japan. = But I was just getting started. After coming home, I knew that I needed to continue my service in the Delta. There are too many injustices and inequalities facing all of our families. Many of our friends and our neighbors are staring down poverty, underfunded schools, lack of quality healthcare, and high unemployment. So I founded a nonprofit where we work to serve and inspire youth from low-income communities, provide career and academic-related resources and the opportunity to work with mentors. Yet, there was still more I could do for my community. So I went to law school and instead of pursuing some far-off lucrative career, I came right back to Mississippi. As an attorney I fought back against landlords trying to force evictions on parents during the COVID-19 crisis, represented workers seeking compensation in the face of unfair employment practices, and low-income Mississippians just trying to get a fair shake in our justice system. = In our communities, I’ve been an advocate for improving our elections by helping to establish organizations supporting women seeking elected office, helping draw fair voting districts to make our democracy fair for all of us, and expanding voting rights to make it easier to access the ballot. As I work alongside other Mississippians, I’m always asking myself “What more can I do for others?” One thing has remained constant – my parents’ lived example of the importance of giving back and using what you have to help others. = I believe the most important thing a leader must do is listen. And, this is the big thing that is missing in Washington today. That's why our campaign motto is “You Talk. I Listen. We Do.” This means our campaign is driven by you talking, telling me what's important to you and your family; me listening, waking up each day thinking about what you say is important to your family and your community; and you and I working together to move Mississippi forward. = = Standing together, Ty * | The son of a tractor driver, Ty doesn’t come from a wealthy family. Dear Peter,
Like many of you, my relationship to my mom Ethel had its ups and downs.
Also like many of you, as I got older, I began to appreciate the extraordinary things my mother gave to our family.
One such epiphany occurred when I had six kids of my own. I remember becoming mystified about how my mother kept our family of eleven children together and on course after my father’s death.
In fact, I stand amazed and in awe of her each and every Mother’s Day, especially her admonition that “Kennedy’s never give up.”
I’ve taken that to heart.
Finally, from my family to yours, Happy Mother’s Day.
| |

Sincerely,
Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

California is home to some of the planet's most treasured natural landscapes. We have an abundance of biodiversity, and with our public lands comes the responsibility to protect them – and the people who enjoy them.

So it was a privilege to receive the Environmental Working Group’s Changemaker 2024 Award for my legislation that keeps hormone disrupting, carcinogenic, and other lethal chemicals out of our environment, out of our personal care products, away from children, and out of our homes.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84704724/472364270/1636625507?refcode=em-5.10.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWM5ZDk1YWYtZjIwZS1lZjExLTk2ZjMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Zi5Q-iMvKdp7QNKra_F91_vPh8rHruRJ37ParNZRLbA=)
I’ve told you that part of why I’m running for Congress is because I worry every day about the world my 10-year-old daughter is inheriting. A breathable, livable planet being one of the chief concerns.

But you know me – my work can’t stop in California just because I’m running a campaign. That’s why I am working this year on efforts like protecting Californians from exposure to the toxic weed killer paraquat, so I can leave the Assembly in a better place than when I started.

I’m honored to be recognized for establishing first-in-the-nation efforts to address these challenges while serving in the California Assembly, and if I’m fortunate enough to be elected to represent CA-30, I’ll work every day to bring that commitment to the national level.

[**While I help improve the lives of Californians in the Assembly, there is still a campaign that could use your support. Thank you,

Laura

**Friends - we wanted to make sure you saw Ilhan's note yesterday about why your support for our progressive movement is critically important to our success, so we're quickly bumping it to the top of your inbox.
**Will you take a moment to read it below, and then**[make your first online contribution — of $3 or any amount that makes sense to you — to stand with Ilhan today?**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240510-1-t2&t=2&akid=1124%2E791427%2E6qXo62)

****
| **[CONTRIBUTE OTHER](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/13?c0=io-em-may24.nKhuVz&refcode=em240510-1-t2&t=4&akid=1124%2E791427%2E6qXo62)**
---
Friends,
I'm reaching out this morning to respectfully ask if you can **[make a contribution — of $3 or any amount — to my campaign today.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240510-1-t2&t=5&akid=1124%2E791427%2E6qXo62)
Here's why:
When I first ran for Congress in 2018, I decided to reject money from corporate PACs and billionaires. At the time, people saw it as a big move, but to me, it was barely a decision at all.
My team and I felt that the _only_ way we could build a movement and run a campaign that stuck true to our shared progressive values was to lead by example. And that started by funding it all the right way — together.
Since then, hundreds of thousands of supporters from all across the country have stood by my side and proven us right. That together, a mass movement of everyday working people could fund not just one, but three winning congressional campaigns $5, $15, and $50 at a time.
It will come as no surprise that running our campaigns this way requires a monumental grassroots effort, and that a significant portion of our budget each month comes from small-dollar donations made to emails just like this one.
_That's_ why I'm reaching out this morning. Because from time to time we need to ask, and today is one of those days:
**[Can you please make a contribution — of $3 or any amount — to stand with our re-election campaign for Congress today? I would not ask if your support were not so important to our success.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240510-1-t2&t=6&akid=1124%2E791427%2E6qXo62)**

| | **[Donate $3](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/14?c0=io-em-may24.vHlicq&refcode=em240510-1-t2&t=25&akid=1124%2E791427%2E6qXo62)**
---
****
| **[Donate $25](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/15?c0=io-em-may24.G4AfBH&refcode=em240510-1-t2&t=26&akid=1124%2E791427%2E6qXo62)**
---
****
| | **[Donate $50](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/8?c0=io-em-may24.7TPvPe&refcode=em240510-1-t2&t=27&akid=1124%2E791427%2E6qXo62)**
---
****
| **[Donate $100](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/9?c0=io-em-may24.MrE-C8&refcode=em240510-1-t2&t=28&akid=1124%2E791427%2E6qXo62)**
---
****
| | **[Donate $250](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/10?c0=io-em-may24.atU-PH&refcode=em240510-1-t2&t=29&akid=1124%2E791427%2E6qXo62)**
---
****
| **[Other Amount](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/13?c0=io-em-may24.nKhuVz&refcode=em240510-1-t2&t=30&akid=1124%2E791427%2E6qXo62)**
---
****
Our opponents in this race — the dark money super PACs, the billionaires who fund them, right-wing special interest groups like AIPAC — they're gearing up to do and spend whatever it takes to defeat us.
Bigoted television ads blanketing the airwaves, attack mailers in every mailbox, conveniently-timed fundraising efforts for my opponent — it's all coming.
We know because they tried the same tactics against my friend Summer Lee in Pennsylvania before her victory last month. They're trying the same tactics against my friend Jamaal Bowman in New York as we speak.
As this election heats up in the months ahead, they're going to turn their focus toward our movement here in Minnesota — and you can be certain that they're not funding their work through small-dollar, grassroots donations.
It's going to take ALL of us standing together to fight back and defeat them. So please, I'm respectfully asking:
**[Can you use this link to make a contribution — of $3 or anything you can afford — to stand with our movement today? I rely on people like you to help fund this campaign.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240510-1-t2&t=31&akid=1124%2E791427%2E6qXo62)
As always, thank you for everything. Not just for your financial support, but for your passion, your encouragement, and for all that you bring to our collective struggle for justice.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: Does voter registration even work?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

I am hosting a call this coming Tuesday, May 14th to give you a chance to
join us in registering Texas voters. I’ll explain how our program works,
how it’s different from anything else in Texas (or the rest of the country
for that matter) and how you can play a leading role in signing up voters
who can make the difference in close elections across the state.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63447?t=1001&akid=239578%2E444211%2EoAu9tc ]Sign up here to join us on Tuesday.

But first, you might be wondering, does voter registration even work? Is
it the most effective thing we can be doing with our time?

The short answer:
Yes. And yes.

The longer answer:
More Democratic voters mean more opportunities for Democratic candidates
to win. But until now, there has not been a consistent, effective and
partisan voter registration effort in Texas.

That means Democratic campaigns are forced to focus exclusively on
already-registered voters, many millions of whom do not vote for whatever
reason (we don’t have good contact information for them; they no longer
care about elections; or they are unable to overcome the most aggressive
voter suppression in the country). Relying on the already-registered
electorate keeps us coming up short in crucial races.

It also means that the non-partisan voter registration efforts that do
take place in Texas are adding both Democrats and Republicans to the voter
rolls. The cost of being non-profit and non-partisan is that you can’t
target based on party affiliation. In a state that is so dominated by
Republicans who have so radically tilted the playing field to their
advantage, we can’t afford that either.

Powered by People is different. We are a partisan political organization
with one mission: electing Democrats to office in Texas. Our program
focuses on registering likely Democrats and then, importantly, staying in
touch with these newly registered voters ahead of November so that they
are much more likely to vote. The partisan screening and personal follow
up set us apart and, if we have enough volunteers working with us over the
coming months, will help set Democratic candidates up for success.

Another question you might have for me, will this work?

The honest answer:
It depends.

We’ve tested this partisan registration and relationship-building program
with a small group of dedicated volunteers for the last two months and the
results have been promising. We are registering Democrats at a strong clip
and have successfully maintained contact with them after registration.

But whether we can reach a scale that will make the difference in key
elections across the state depends on how many volunteers sign up to do
the work. And to be clear, the work isn’t easy. It involves training,
teamwork and a willingness to meet future voters wherever they are:
college campuses, concerts, parks, among other public spaces. But I am
confident that it is the work that will make the greatest difference over
time.

I’ve always said that winning in Texas is a matter of time and effort. The
more of us willing to put in the effort, the sooner we’ll be there.

Now, a question for you: how long do you want to wait?

See you Tuesday,

Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to act. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1002&akid=239578%2E444211%2EoAu9tc

I received a death threat from Beijing because I love Liberty, Freedom, and the United States of America. More on that in a minute.

Right now, I want to introduce myself.

_My name is Lily Tang Williams, and I fled Communist China and escaped the evil Communist indoctrination. I'm running for Congress because I fear the country I love is becoming like the country I left._

You see: I was born to illiterate working-class parents in China's western Sichuan province just before Mao's Cultural Revolution. I grew up in extremely poor living conditions with food rationing, social chaos, and indoctrination into Communism.

At a young age, I learned a hard lesson about surviving in a Communist regime: conform and keep your thoughts private. Do not trust anyone, even your friends.

Everything changed when an American exchange student showed me a pocket-sized version of "The Declaration of Independence." Even with my limited English skills, I could understand most of these words: "We hold these truths to be self–evident...." It's like a lightbulb came on. I had never heard such beautiful words before, and I loved them so much that I spent many hours with my American friend to learn more about these new concepts and America.

_**I had a new dream: I wanted to go to America.**_

In 1988, I made it to America with only $100 in my pocket, which I borrowed, along with a $1,200 loan from my sponsor. I spoke very little English. In the 33 years since I have enjoyed living in this great country. I received a graduate degree, got married, raised three children, started my own business, and was naturalized as a U.S. citizen in 1995.

Fast forward to today: I've spoken out against Communism and Socialism appearing on Fox News, Tucker Carlson Tonight, Fox Business, Newsmax, Timcast, Huckabee TV, John Stossel, Joe Pags Show, Gothix TV, Shawn Ryan Show, Epoch Times TV, and Glenn Beck Radio.

I've authored opinion articles for The Epoch Times, Town Hall, National Review, Union Leader, Concord Monitor, and Granite Grok.

_And here's where the death threats from Beijing started: when I decided to run for Congress._

The Democrats don't want my story to reach the ears of my fellow Americans because they hope to enact their Socialist Agenda.

But more importantly, you and I cannot afford to let the woke liberal elite plunge the America we know and love any further down the dark path of Communism and trample on our God-given rights.

_Believe me. I'm not fear-mongering when I say you cannot imagine the horrors of Socialism and Communism. It is evil._

It’s outrageous that in the richest country in the world, people have to worry about whether they’ll be able to afford needed care if they or a loved one becomes sick or gets into an accident.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84706443/472369586/150430950?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWU4ZDU2Yi1mNjBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wpmWgkWHEHQxFUigxlIuUA3nZOOZwAo6ihXCzKjwlvY=&emci=f58afcfa-f50e-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=bae8d56b-f60e-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=7731215)

| | It's outrageous that in the richest country in the world, people have to worry about whether they'll be able to afford needed care if they or a loved one becomes sick or gets into an accident. **We need to make sure every American has access to high-quality, affordable health care.** Luckily, we already have an effective, popular solution: Medicare. By offering every American the opportunity for Medicare coverage, we can move consumers and businesses further along the path toward universal health care. **I reintroduced the**** _Choose Medicare Act_****because I want to make sure every American has the option to buy in if they want to.** This legislation opens up Medicare to all Americans and builds on the system we have today. By allowing Medicare to compete with private health insurance, we're giving consumers and businesses choice on the path to universal health care and lowering health care and prescription drug costs, too. I'm working hard to improve health care affordability while increasing access, competition, and choice. **The**** _Choose Medicare Act_****would do just that.** Right now, we have a choice between a system that gets more and more expensive every year, leaves middle-class families one pink slip away from losing their health coverage, and makes our businesses less competitive, or an improved model that increases health care options, expands care, and lowers costs. We can't afford to do nothing, and that's why I'm urging the Senate to pass the _Choose Medicare Act_. Right now, we have a choice between a system that gets more and more expensive every year, leaves middle-class families one pink slip away from losing their health coverage, and makes our businesses less competitive, or an improved model that increases health care options, expands care, and lowers costs. We can't afford to do nothing, and that's why I'm urging the Senate to pass the Choose Medicare Act. Onward! Dear Peter,
Happy Washington Day! As the 42nd state to join the union, we take pride in our diverse and beautiful landscapes, from the enchanting Lake Chelan to the charming town of Leavenworth. Whether exploring the attractions or enjoying the small-town charm of Sultan and Covington, Washington has something for everyone. As your congresswoman, I will protect the beauty we’ve come to love.

My campaign is dedicated to preserving what makes our district unique while championing progress that benefits all our communities. Our vision for a prosperous and sustainable future is rooted in policies that support economic growth, community safety, and educational excellence.

subject: Celebrating John Walsh's Memory at the Roosevelt Awards

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Dear Peter,
The MassDems are proud to announce that longtime Democratic activist, and former MassDems Chair, John Walsh will be posthumously honored with a Roosevelt Award at the 25th Annual Massachusetts Democratic Party Dinner. Sadly, we lost John in November 2023, leaving behind an inspiring legacy of leadership deserving of our enduring gratitude.
John’s love of politics was unmatched. He was an unrelenting advocate for our party, one of its strongest recruiters in support of our candidates and the causes we share. I’m proud that MassDems is continuing to honor John and his legacy and can only hope we continue to live up to it.
Along with a litany of impactful leadership positions, John served as Chief of Staff in the office of Senator Ed Markey, who shared this in response to the news of the Roosevelt Award:
"John Walsh dedicated his hands and his heart to action – to building, growing, and expanding participation in our democracy through the Democratic Party. He believed, without fail, in the grassroots and trusted the organizers on the ground to find solutions. John Walsh brought a deep and profound level of humanity to every campaign he led and to his leadership as Chair of the Massachusetts Democratic Party, embodying the spirit and actions of Roosevelt Award recipients."
Join us in celebrating John at this year’s Annual Dinner, with tickets available here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/roo25] . Mark your calendar for Thursday, June 13th, from 6:00 - 8:00 PM at the Fairmont Copley Plaza Hotel located at 138 Saint James Avenue in Boston.
We’ll also be recognizing the Honorable Speaker Bob DeLeo and Linda Whitlock with Roosevelt Awards, alongside Rebecca Hart Holder who will be receiving the Activist Award in memory of Chris Condon on behalf of all Reproductive Freedom activists.
Secure your sponsorships and tickets here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/roo25] to ensure your attendance at this unforgettable celebration.
I look forward to celebrating with you as we honor these exceptional individuals and their remarkable achievements.
Warm regards,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Steve%20K%27s%20Signature.png]
Steve Kerrigan

body:
| | | [ ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=521871d48e&e=a7ab36849c)
---
| | Dear Freedom Fighters,

On Monday morning I had the honor of once again attending the annual Arizona Department of Public Safety’s officer memorial ceremony complete with bagpipes and a flyover. Each year this event is sponsored by the Arizona State Troopers Association. Government exists for public safety. I am proud to support our men and women in uniform. You can watch the ceremony [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=edcc51454b&e=a7ab36849c). #BacktheBlue.

On Monday afternoon we were alerted by Hobbs’ office that [Senate Bill 1376](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=f198b7358e&e=a7ab36849c), a bill I had sponsored for [ABATE of Arizona](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=65d7c7e986&e=a7ab36849c), was signed into law. This legislation will help ensure safer roads for all drivers by hopefully decreasing roadway debris and increasing motorist safety. In 2020, data released by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration includes the following statistics: 82,479 crashes, 16,595 injuries, and 715 fatalities alone due to unsecured loads in Arizona. ABATE of Arizona is an organization dedicated to the protection and promotion of motorcyclists’ rights and safety. #lookformotorcycles

On Tuesday, the Center for Education Reform released its [“Parent Power Index”](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=423a898a99&e=a7ab36849c) measuring how much power parents have in their state over their children’s schools. This index evaluated state policies based on how school aged children are educated. As you can see, Arizona ranks #2 in the country. Their index shows that Arizona is doing a decent job in this arena, but still has room for improvement because we came in second place. As a parent of two children who attended Arizona’s K-12 public school system, I applaud parents for holding our schools accountable and demanding a high-quality education. I support students over systems, allowing families to best choose their child’s educational outcomes. I came back to the State Capitol to protect school choice and that’s what I intend to do.

On Wednesday, we held a press conference on [HCR2060](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3f64681882&e=a7ab36849c), the Secure Border Act will allow the State of Arizona to oversee border security since the Biden Administration continues to fail us. This bill has many provisions of a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=86ee507d68&e=a7ab36849c) that Hobbs vetoed earlier this session. If this bill passes both the House and Senate, it will be sent to the Secretary of State’s office to be put on the November ballot, allowing Arizona’s registered voters to weigh in. You can read more about it [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=0061632c18&e=a7ab36849c).

After the joint House and Senate press conference on Wednesday afternoon, a Joint Committee on Senate Military Affairs, Public Safety and Border Security and House Committee on the Judiciary held a public hearing to discuss HCR2060. You can rewatch it [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=f8c9bcafe3&e=a7ab36849c).

Also, on Wednesday a Newsweek contributor published this [well-articulated article](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3dcbeac97b&e=a7ab36849c) framing Arizona’s recent abortion debate and the future of our state's constitution if Planned Parenthood places the [Arizona for Abortion Access Ac](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6e31515891&e=a7ab36849c)[t](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d993a30473&e=a7ab36849c) on this fall's ballot.

On Thursday, the Senate was in session all day and into the early evening to debate HCR2060. Currently, Arizona spends [$2.3 billion a year](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6d44f02b3f&e=a7ab36849c) on expenditures for illegal aliens. By sending HCR2060 to the November ballot, voters can help turn off any incentives that might attract illegal aliens from entering our state. We need to establish and enforce penalties against illegal border crossings. This bill was also modeled after [Texas’ Senate Bill 4](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=49ff78998d&e=a7ab36849c). Currently, this legislation is being litigated in the 5th Circuit Court of Appeals. If HCR2060 is passed by the Arizona’s voters, the new law wouldn’t take effect until 60 days after the Texas Senate Bill 4 was ruled constitutional.

This coming week expect a vote in the House and Senate on HCR2060. Also, on Tuesday, one of my election bills, [Senate Bill 1374](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3a66cb4b53&e=a7ab36849c) is being revived into an election’s omnibus. SB1374 was voted out of the Senate earlier this session, but sadly [Representative Jacqueline Parker](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=a627b1be94&e=a7ab36849c) refused to hear this important bill in the House Committee on Elections. Sadly, some elected officials put personality differences over what is more important for the future of Arizona.

The State of Louisiana voters [unanimously approved](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=f8487b0fdc&e=a7ab36849c) this same measure last election cycle. Hopefully, Arizona will also have the fortitude to do the same come November. Americans overwhelmingly reject foreign interference in our elections. Yet, there is a Swiss billionaire named Hansjorg Wyss who has funneled more than [$500 million in funds](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=8ef69ca9aa&e=a7ab36849c) to Democrat’s political coffers and issue du jour by way of state ballot initiatives, including enshrining abortion on demand into several red and blue state’s constitutions. In Ohio (and other states) in 2023, [voters approved a constitutional amendment](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=f99729a97e&e=a7ab36849c) to create a right to an abortion.

Planned Parenthood and other left-wing groups have been relying on Wyss’ foreign dollars to enshrine abortion on demand into several state’s constitutions. Just this week in the State of Ohio, the Republican-controlled Ohio Senate voted along party lines to pass legislation to ban foreign contributions to state ballot measure campaigns. Even the OH Secretary of State, Frank LaRose, [renewed his call to ban foreign donations](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=b7f7247244&e=a7ab36849c) in their state’s elections. A constituent asked me this morning how much money the [It Goes Too Far](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3f41e4110e&e=a7ab36849c) campaign has raised so far to defeat Planned Parenthood’s Arizona Abortion Access Act. As of March 31st, the opposition campaign to Planned Parenthood’s abortion on demand initiative had [$338,633.54](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=555eab5921&e=a7ab36849c) cash on hand. If Ohio is any indication, the It Goes Too Far campaign will be outspent through the end of the November general election. Again, I call on the pro-life community to donate their time and treasure to help defeat this initiative.

On Tuesday, I hope you will join me in supporting my bill to ban foreign donations in our state’s elections. You you can tune into the Senate Committee on Elections [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=1c78f88030&e=a7ab36849c) to hear the status of the strike everything to HCR2032.

Thanks again for all your continued support. I truly appreciate you!

Take care,
Shawnna

* Angie Nixon, State Representative FL House District 13
* Madinah Wilson-Anton, State Representative DE House District 26

Over 610,000 displaced children are trapped in Rafah, with nowhere else to go. As our government is not just complicit but is actively participating in the genocide of the Palestinian people, the U.S. House of Representatives has passed a bill that could criminalize protesters who criticize the Israeli government. Rather than listen to what the vast majority of their constituents are demanding, many lawmakers at the state and federal level have encouraged brutal crackdowns on peaceful anti-genocide protests— undermining our constitutional rights. In just the past few weeks, over 2,000 students and faculty have been arrested, and many have been hospitalized from police forces’ rubber bullets and beatings. We need more elected leaders who defend our rights and who clearly denounce war crimes. name: Russ Vought
subject: We shouldn’t be paying the defense bills of rich European countries.
body:
We’re fighting on multiple fronts against this lawless president | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us1.campaign-archive.com/?e=17913c7d6d&u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=6078e32d39)
---
| | |
---
| | | Friends,

It’s been a busy week at the Center.

We’re fighting on multiple fronts against this lawless president and we continue to make the case that the U.S. shouldn’t be paying the defense bills of rich European countries.

Last month marked the 75th anniversary of NATO. In that time, t**he U.S. has contributed more than[$21.9 trillion](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=6f0bf3d6e7&e=17913c7d6d) to defend the borders of European countries** while millions of illegals pour across our wide open southern border.

In 2023 alone, American taxpayers sent over **$860 billion to NATO** , while our national debt has skyrocketed to nearly $35 trillion.

As my colleague Sumantra Maitra explains, it’s time for America to pivot away from Europe and adopt a “dormant NATO” strategy that allows the US to shift the security burden to Europe rapidly. If you’re pressed for time, we outlined the core tenets of the strategy in a recent Twitter/X**[thread](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=7d8a0237bd&e=17913c7d6d)**.

**Policy Brief:****[Pivoting the US Away from Europe to a Dormant NATO](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=0c911224c6&e=17913c7d6d)**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=74475c35fe&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| [Vought Hits Biden’s “Lawless Presidency” on Fox Business](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=23b95e29c3&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=7e1e58c0c3&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| This past week I joined my friend Larry Kudlow on Fox Business to discuss the latest push by Joe Biden’s lawless administration to ram progressive policies like regulations on gas stoves and refrigerators.

As I explained to Larry, “they take every policy and breathe as much leftism and progressivism into it as they possibly can and then they send it to the courts and hope that it sticks.”

It’s incremental tyranny and the only thing standing in their way is Trump-appointed judges willing to stop them.

**Watch:****[CRA President Russ Vought Slams Biden’s Lawless Presidency](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=fcf4a9dccb&e=17913c7d6d)**
---
| [The Left promotes the Great Replacement... but call you a racist for noticing](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=1def13316a&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=1612a41a7d&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| CRA’s Wade Miller recently joined The Charlie Kirk Show to explain how woke and weaponized federal bureaucracies are willfully assisting the demographic replacement of American citizens.

He’s right, of course, and it’s been well-documented. But when the left is called out on it, they call you a racist.

As Wade points out, “prominent figures from all over the center-left spectrum actively admit they want to change the make-up of this country.. they’ve created this cottage industry where it’s politically correct to be anti-white.”

**Policy Brief:[The Great Replacement in Theory and Practice](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=0be4181830&e=17913c7d6d)**

Friends, the hour is late for our Republic. The left’s anti-American ideology, rooted in Marxism, has pushed us to the brink.

**But American renewal is still possible if we’re willing to fight for it.

[Can we count on your support?](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=de29bda636&e=17913c7d6d)**
---
| Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President, Citizens for Renewing America

1. Idaho v. US – If Idaho gets their way, even if a woman's life is in danger, she may not be able to get an abortion. It's literally a death sentence.
2. FDA v. Alliance for Hippocratic Medicine – This right-wing interest group is trying to cut off our access to mifepristone, a drug the FDA has found is incredibly safe (and is now used in the majority of abortions).

As a woman, as a veteran... it guts me that the very freedom I risked my life for might be taken away from us. But what really pisses me off is that this shouldn't even be up to the Supreme Court. No matter how much you’re able to give, every single dollar makes a huge difference! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12693558?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My Fellow Floridians,

Following the legislative session, I have been very busy out in the community, attending events, meeting with constituents, and learning more about how I can make **House District 24** a better place. **There is a lot of behind-the-scenes work that goes into being a state legislator!** In this week’s newsletter, I want to share with you what I have been up to and some important state updates.

If there is something I can do for you, please do not hesitate to get in touch with my office. I want to work with you to build a brighter future for our district and state. **You can contact my office by****[clicking here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=72706dc082&e=d1c1b9864f "https://www.myfloridahouse.gov/Sections/Representatives/contactmember.aspx?MemberId=4901&SessionId=103&utm_source=Ryan+Chamberlin+for+State+Representative&utm_campaign=ae0a433299-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_08_05_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7ddd94a0de-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D").** I look forward to hearing from you soon!
---
| | **Re-Election Event for U.S. Senator Rick Scott **
---
|
---
---
| My staff and I had the opportunity to attend an event for the re-election of **U.S. Senator Rick Scott** hosted by my good friend **Danny Gaekwad**. Senator Scott has done great work during his time in **Congress** , holding the line against the radical liberal agenda. I’m proud to support him for re-election.
---
| | **Marion County Tea Party Meeting**
---
|
---
---
| It was great to speak at the **Marion County Tea Party** meeting. I expressed to the attendees how exciting it is to represent the **Great State of Florida**. We still have a lot of work to do, but if the other 49 states were more like Florida, we would have a different country. I enjoyed sharing our state’s progress with the community.
---
| | **100% Pro-Business Voting Record Award**
---
|
---
| I had the pleasure of attending the **AIF Orlando** candidate reception honoring incumbent legislators and candidates for the **Florida Legislature**. I was proud to receive an award for voting for pro-business legislation during the **2024 Legislative Session**. I will always be a champion for Florida entrepreneurs and small business owners in the legislature.
---
| | **Legislation Signed - HB 7073 - Tax Relief**
---
|
---
| This week, **Governor Ron DeSantis** signed a major tax relief bill into law. **HB 7073** will provide **billions of dollars in tax relief for Floridians** , including tax holidays on **back-to-school supplies** , **disaster preparedness items** , and **toll transactions**. View the infographic included above to learn more! Thank you, **Governor DeSantis** , for helping Florida families keep more money in their pockets.
---
| | **Other Bills Signed by Governor DeSantis This Week**
---
| Governor DeSantis is doing great work for our state, and it has been an honor to serve alongside his leadership in the legislature to make Florida even stronger.

**Below is a list of the legislation our governor signed into law this week. **

[CS/CS/HB 1473 - School Safety](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=4026c9d0dc&e=d1c1b9864f)

[CS/CS/HB 285 - Public Records](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=a7f97462d4&e=d1c1b9864f)
[CS/CS/HB 1077 - Clerks of Court](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=370e3c9f22&e=d1c1b9864f)
[CS/HB 761 - Interpersonal Violence Injunction Petitions](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=fa1b7e7509&e=d1c1b9864f)

body:
Republican legislators are failing our teachers and students.

|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84721332/472402857/823540626?refcode=ea.629763c4-090f-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.629763c4-090f-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2Mjk3NjNjNC0wOTBmLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4RXwOGEcZQpo7AwTObC5Q-I5hScXUPz-pJnsQaOjRlU=&emci=83ec2af5-ee0e-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=629763c4-090f-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=1049176)
This week, America celebrated Teacher Appreciation Week and thanked public school teachers across the country for the essential role they play in shaping our future generations. But, for all the thanks we give and all the appreciation we show, it’s not enough. **Public school teachers are underpaid — sometimes having to work second and third jobs just to pay the bills. Meanwhile, they’re pouring their own money into their classrooms, trying to give their students the education they deserve.** Peter, my mother was a public school teacher in North Carolina, so I know firsthand just how hard our teachers work. _And they deserve pay that adequately compensates them for it._ I declared 2024 as the Year of Public Schools because I believe it’s critical to highlight the good work being done in the classrooms where more than 8 in 10 North Carolina students learn every day. As Governor, I’ve prioritized giving public school teachers a raise and fully funding our public schools so that teachers don’t have to pay out of pocket for the supplies they need. Growing up, Mom made sure that our birthdays, holidays, and all our special events were filled with joy and laughter. She’s always been thoughtful, dedicated, and quick-witted, and her ability to juggle being a mom and grandmother while addressing the needs of her constituents and communities is an inspiration to us. **We learned from the best.**

— Pat, Harry, and Alex

# Geomagnetic storm begins tonight, extends through weekend
Worried about the incoming [geomagnetic storm](https://substack.com/redirect/bb9d6358-a476-4c0b-ad83-c64eec2e071b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)? [Read more here.](https://substack.com/redirect/1aa83ad1-b8fe-4497-ae83-32946c46a933?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Earth experienced a [similar solar incident in 2005](https://substack.com/redirect/dd43ba29-3440-4ac1-b8c8-d55bed4d94ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), when a G4-level event (_yep, solar storms have categories like tornadoes and hurricanes_) in September caused mild disruption to radio waves and devices dependent upon them.
That was nearly 20 years ago, though, and technology has evolved since then, making it less susceptible to disruptions of frequency-based technology and devices.
The most vulnerable sectors are communications and satellite based systems, like GPS, though there is marginal risk of electric pulses that may disrupt the energy sector...

**Meet Bernie Moreno:** | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=3b0b882469d74f1bb0bde46004135592&_e=zoKJ9JKi4BTjHmiuHNRlkGZeMnaQoDlbhCDUWaTE_RajnH3zGv48Rh3j_kXqPhfhHsvoPeTaOPjTmZJy0os_Ii_0PWJthWDFDm_mCIAsEpaEsp4lGti3usIRdnNEy3bp3deX-MoUROXtHsXJol46Oc6V00cQrKqTakbtW1LL6sEqB3Yzw-r57SzpIQVSHkxHqQxk-11pB7VdeUdaqjMRmuSIbYrpg-tJHEWQmc811UexzkLLbTKTl9VoA5kumWt2KVVEO6rizp2OIDjC4rC2-wPFWv0-AUPjDqcj3-bJmETZEooJHuDfM8cZLUgjssrAGICkP41YoGDSsFLXXg_dFtzRWuqYc_BiLQzGR7digTcSIOVCnxVk6pHEk4OM-AUfMsoA9QyR9TXltdGT16lBNg%3D%3D) Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.
