The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** Dr. Valerie McCray Wins Democratic Nomination For U.S. Senate Dr. Valerie McCray became the first Black woman in Indiana history to be a major party nominee for United States Senate on Tuesday. Dr. McCray believes strongly in improving mental health outcomes for Hoosiers, and tackling Indiana’s opioid epidemic. She also understands that we must pass federal protections to codify Roe v. Wade as the law of the land. The differences couldn’t be clearer between her and MAGA cheerleader Jim Banks, who is more loyal to Donald Trump than average Hoosiers. Jennifer McCormick Ready to Take on Mike Braun After Primary Jennifer McCormick has advanced past the primary, and is ready to stop Indiana from going further down a path of one-party control after Mike Braun won the six-way clown car primary to be the Indiana GOP’s gubernatorial nominee. The contrast with our nominee could not be more clear. Braun wants to criminalize abortion access in Indiana, while McCormick will fight to restore the right to choose for every Hoosier woman. Braun has also said interracial marriage should not be protected federally, and other fundamental freedoms that we enjoy should be stripped. We must not allow him to be our next governor. Jennifer McCormick will fight for public education, and to keep the government out of the doctors’ office. Jennifer will continue listening to Hoosiers through November, and advocating for a better path forward for our state. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. Republicans are trying to force the private medical records of Hoosier women out into the open, despite a warning from Indiana’s public access counselor that such a move would endanger patient safety and privacy. Indiana’s near-total abortion ban has forced countless women into an impossible decision. The law needs to be repealed, but instead Republicans only wish to punish women, and add more restrictions. Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84724767/472412053/-933762732?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240510_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OWQxY2U0MC0xMDBmLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WQY2i8cd428duILbloh_EsTcTxsyWa4p5fRPGmPVvxU=) Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain.

I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips.

**I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84724768/472412054/-933762732?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240510_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OWQxY2U0MC0xMDBmLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WQY2i8cd428duILbloh_EsTcTxsyWa4p5fRPGmPVvxU=) My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family.

Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families.

You see, the New York City government shoveled over _$100 million in government aid_ to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. _They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street._

But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress.

Right now, the shadow of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families _– and they’re raising millions to pull it off._

But we have something they don’t, Peter: A powerful grassroots movement made up of working people, not faceless corporations. Ritchie Torres represents the future of the Democratic Party. Raised by a single mother in public housing, Ritchie personally understands the hardships that working families endure. At age 25, Ritchie made history as the youngest elected official to serve on the New York City Council. He fought tirelessly for the working families of The Bronx, and now, he's fighting for those families and for progressive values in Congress. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Airline travelers no longer have to wait on hold for a measly voucher refund
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
No more upbeat elevator music and refunds in the form of flight credits

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2165%2E4032634%2E2PJem4)
---
If you’ve ever experienced the sheer joy of a flight getting canceled and sitting on the floor of a terminal while on hold with customer service, listening to upbeat elevator music for hours in order to receive a refund in the form of a measly voucher, I’ve got great news for you. The Biden-Harris administration recently announced new rules that protect airline travelers, including:
* Requiring airlines to automatically give full cash refunds — not vouchers, not flight credits — for canceled and significantly delayed flights.
* Making it so airlines can no longer call their own shots for what defines “significantly delayed.” Across the board, customers will receive refunds for domestic flights that are delayed more than three hours and international flights that are delayed more than six hours.
* Applying these protections for tickets purchased directly from airlines, travel agents and third-party sites.
* Requiring airlines to give automatic cash refunds if your bags are lost and not delivered within 12 hours.

Sounds great, right? But we faced a roadblock while getting this across the finish line. You see, the Senate just negotiated these new rules as part of the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024, and I noticed one line in the bill that completely stripped the “automatic” part out of the automatic refunds. Instead of automatically getting their money back, customers would be forced to manually request refunds in writing or online, wasting time and energy. I knew this would be a gift to the airline companies, who know many travelers won’t have the time or resources to navigate the bureaucratic process they designed. **So I fought back and filed a bipartisan amendment to make those refunds _actually_ automatic and crack down on these ways airlines make it harder for consumers to get their money back.** [**We fought, and we delivered. Last night, the Senate passed these new rules that protect travelers — with those _actually_ automatic refunds guaranteed. I’m going to keep fighting to stop airline companies and big corporations from taking advantage of consumers. If you’re able, can you please chip in $28 or anything you can to support this important work?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2186?amount=28&t=8&akid=2165%2E4032634%2E2PJem4)

---

---

---
| [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2186?t=20&express_lane=true&akid=2165%2E4032634%2E2PJem4)
---

---
Rampant flight cancellations and delays have cost Americans time, money, and memories they could be making on long-awaited trips — and the companies responsible are not being held accountable. While travelers are forced to sleep on terminal chairs instead of spending the holidays with their families, airline executives still pocket the money they got for unmet services. Enough. For years, I’ve called for new consumer protection rules for airline passengers, urging the Department of Transportation to fine airlines that delay or cancel flights because of staffing or operational issues. The Biden-Harris administration has taken this issue seriously, and the new proposed rules will drastically rebalance the power dynamic between consumers and airline companies. And I’m glad the Senate passed my amendment that put American families ahead of airline profit and ensured the automatic refunds would actually be automatic. **This is just another way we can put the government on the side of working people, not corporations, and I’m fighting hard to keep delivering these wins for working people.** [**If you’re able to pitch in $28 or anything you can today, you’ll ensure we can keep up this fight in the Senate to stop corporations from taking advantage of consumers.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2186?amount=28&t=14&akid=2165%2E4032634%2E2PJem4) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

**_Jimmy’s Original Message:_**

Peter,

This week is National Teacher Appreciation Week and I wanted to take a moment to thank all the dedicated educators who work tirelessly, and often thanklessly, to educate us throughout our lives.

Our educators are some of the fiercest public servants our nation has, and they deserve to be recognized for their hard work and dedication, **this week and every week.**

That’s why I’ve started a card thanking all teachers for their commitment to the education of the next generation of leaders and change-makers.

_**[Sign here to thank teachers, and share your own story about a teacher who changed your life.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84728333/472423814/-1967886486?source=EM_NBI_JP_20240510_PT_TAW_0_3MO_TeamPanetta_NA_NA_TAW2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTQxNGUxZC0xYjBmLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3nX_TuouXNPodZnMQYPExUQQ2KlA9ucNZA9jJx5Eoi0=&emci=bc003415-1b0f-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=15414e1d-1b0f-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=6108787)**_

Education is a gateway to self-advancement, innovation, and success, but none of that would be possible without the work of our teachers.

Across America, teachers provide their students with the essential tools to become educated and engaged citizens. Far too often, teachers spend money out of their own pockets to ensure their classrooms have everything their students need. That’s why I’m proud to have introduced bipartisan legislation like the Supporting Early-Childhood Educators’ Deductions (SEED) Act to make sure that tax deductions for school supplies are available to all teachers, including early childhood educators. Through legislation like the SEED Act, we can support our educators as they have supported us.

The efforts of educators are the stepping stones to success, and while we can’t thank them enough, we can certainly try.

_**[This week, please join me in thanking teachers for their dedication to providing a great education for every student, and share your own story about a teacher who impacted your life.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84728337/472423818/-1967886486?source=EM_NBI_JP_20240510_PT_TAW_0_3MO_TeamPanetta_NA_NA_TAW2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTQxNGUxZC0xYjBmLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3nX_TuouXNPodZnMQYPExUQQ2KlA9ucNZA9jJx5Eoi0=&emci=bc003415-1b0f-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=15414e1d-1b0f-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=6108787)**_

clean_body: During her first term in Congress, I’ve seen Hillary fight for West Michigan as strongly as she fights for our family. | = | Hey, there – It’s Jesse, Hillary’s husband (and also her number one fan!). Hillary’s dedication, compassion, and excellence shine through in every role she fills, from social worker to lawyer to my amazing partner in life to Congresswoman. But above all, her most exceptional role is being an unparalleled mom to our two boys (three if you count Smoky, which we do). This job is so tough, but Hill always finds time to be there for our boys–whether it’s homework help across the miles, cheering (ok, a little too loud) on the sidelines of their sporting events, or her nightly story hour (whether at home or through Zoom when she’s in DC). She shows up for her boys, just like she shows up for her constituents and her country. = = | = | = During her first term in Congress, I’ve seen Hillary fight for West Michigan as strongly as she fights for our family. While the boys and I miss her when she’s in Washington, we couldn’t be prouder of the work she’s doing for our communities. How cool is it that these guys get to watch their mom show West Michigan and the world all the things a Mom leader can do? We need more of this. body:
#
Alexandria’s community sent her to Congress on purpose to disrupt and challenge a lot of what’s wrong in D.C.
But during her first term, many people in her own party said her election was a fluke, a mistake, and that there was “nothing to worry about.” Many believed that Alexandria would be a one-term Congresswoman.
One colleague in Congress said they were “shocked” to see how hostile her own party was towards Alexandria from the moment she arrived.
It was clear from the beginning that many in the party never wanted Alexandria there. **It’s why a ‘moderate’ Democrat, multimillionaire ex-Wall Street banker is now trying to buy her seat in the primary election in just 7 weeks**.
But a shift is taking place. And our grassroots movement is saying to the moneyed interests trying to unseat progressives: it ain’t working anymore. **Our lives are worth fighting for**.
[**Will you make your first $5 contribution today to help us fight back? Every dollar ensures that we can reach progressive voters all across New York’s 14th so Alexandria wins by a HUGE margin in June.**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240510.Ih3WVL&refcode=em20240510-6382-P_FND_EGR_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6382%2E2526796%2ENJLbHV)

We need to send Alexandria back to Congress so she can continue doing what she was elected to do: **disrupt, challenge, and demand better**.

Team AOC

# The Frederick Douglass Celebration
A Great American, A Great Republican
**You are Invited to a Milestone Event**
_In Branford, CT, we are taking the lead in rebranding the Republican party and fighting against the false narratives that the GOP are racists, homophobes, and all the other intersectional labels that Democrats throw at us. We know they do this because they cannot stand on their record of abject oppression of minorities and the working class._
_We want to invite you to an event that highlights the Republican Party's inclusive roots, dating back to 1863 when people like Frederick Douglass transformed the Abolitionist movement into the Republican Party. The party has always stood for inclusivity and the rights of all Americans, no matter their skin color or any other objective identity._
_We are excited to announce the first-ever Frederick Douglass Celebration, where the Branford Republicans will pay homage to a great American and an exceptional Republican - Frederick Douglass._

[Click Here for Tickets, Sponsorships, Advertising ](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=e1601e20e9&e=8763c56857)
|

# Download the Invitation and Share
[Click Here for Tickets, Sponsorships, Advertising ](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=4ebc7159e1&e=8763c56857)
|
---
# Why Frederick Douglass?
**A Force for Uniting the United States:** Frederick Douglass serves as a powerful symbol for Republicans to promote the values and principles that make our nation unique. He was born into slavery in 1818, but later became one of the leading advocates for reuniting our nation as the Civil War came to an end. His strong conviction in the power of our founding values and constitutional principles, along with his self-learned eloquence, helped guide Abraham Lincoln and the recently formed Republican party to win a second term based on these values and principles. Lincoln faced the daunting challenge of rescuing a nation divided by the Civil War.
**Believed in American Principles:** History tells us that Lincoln's wholehearted embrace of Douglass's message of fighting for and preserving the values that formed our nation was not only the winning message, but also the roadmap for reunification. Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds.
**A Symbol of Republican Values:** Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country.
**Frederick Douglass played a crucial role in the birth of the Republican Party:** The Republican Party was founded in 1854 by abolitionists who aimed to end slavery and advocate for the civil rights of Black people, with Frederick Douglass playing a significant role in initiating the political campaign.

The party has always stood for inclusivity and the rights of all Americans, no matter their skin color or any other objective identity. We are excited to announce the first-ever Frederick Douglass Celebration, where the Branford Republicans will pay homage to a great American and an exceptional Republican - Frederick Douglass. | Download the Invitation and Share | Why Frederick Douglass? A Force for Uniting the United States: Frederick Douglass serves as a powerful symbol for Republicans to promote the values and principles that make our nation unique. He was born into slavery in 1818, but later became one of the leading advocates for reuniting our nation as the Civil War came to an end. His strong conviction in the power of our founding values and constitutional principles, along with his self-learned eloquence, helped guide Abraham Lincoln and the recently formed Republican party to win a second term based on these values and principles. Lincoln faced the daunting challenge of rescuing a nation divided by the Civil War. Believed in American Principles: History tells us that Lincoln's wholehearted embrace of Douglass's message of fighting for and preserving the values that formed our nation was not only the winning message, but also the roadmap for reunification. Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds. A Symbol of Republican Values: Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country. Frederick Douglass played a crucial role in the birth of the Republican Party: The Republican Party was founded in 1854 by abolitionists who aimed to end slavery and advocate for the civil rights of Black people, with Frederick Douglass playing a significant role in initiating the political campaign. | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | Copyright (C) 2024 Dominic For CT. We used to be taught to love our nation, cherish our history, and respect our fellow Americans. |

| _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=3cb154a5f8914f009dd18b3bd9616aae&_t=XSeMem6sn1KyzusX9XV1aQoHnIZx4cvH_THDygCQAuT2XVKRxZyi35U566W9xIFSB7NGkg5qNMqfxowg2sFBEbHZyiwVk6Wq_hAfKqnRLIk%3D)_

| | [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3cb154a5f8914f009dd18b3bd9616aae&_e=O_8iRC_cez4GF4PHSQMGOggkn1iBicKJVv3iAf9P1FGFy7X_NbITz5vXwG6w8l7LUXq5H3UiS0Dmw9LZtJ6wvatXR-c6qvcBWD5YKPOWGr31z8FRt7PGJGZuOUfHFUFrE54xPQpbbLw4IAhzbqhCmS6iTBKWxymrC8tggqdSiZrKYp0ZLVLaJBFshXlF1vURpULH1k2PP60wIW_lSTVqp-A9dbTb4TfdmnhdGhqaJqBoyvSc2_i9Ud4kXF9orDc5TS9TtBMi0YSMv16H5QQMREKj5M2CT_ustwcg7jRhl2WBlhSr2iBc89FqTOL1BAALPdjmFcWhomSJky5fRSiBxWO9s2zjXtgUkSNyWcqOFvsvKhGBCZkVoEQltX3w9nM5TNTawbYEQ-Lc1L5-1syZAg%3D%3D)

| Fellow Patriot,

You've probably noticed that children today aren't getting the same kind of education that you and I received when we were growing up.

We used to be taught to love our nation, cherish our history, and respect our fellow Americans. But all of that has changed.

In today's classroom, children are taught that America is fundamentally racist, that our history is one of oppression, and that we should focus on our differences instead of what unites us.

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3cb154a5f8914f009dd18b3bd9616aae&_e=O_8iRC_cez4GF4PHSQMGOggkn1iBicKJVv3iAf9P1FGFy7X_NbITz5vXwG6w8l7LUXq5H3UiS0Dmw9LZtJ6wvatXR-c6qvcBWD5YKPOWGr31z8FRt7PGJGZuOUfHFUFrE54xPQpbbLw4IAhzbqhCmS6iTBKWxymrC8tggqdSiZrKYp0ZLVLaJBFshXlF1vURpULH1k2PP60wIW_lSTVqp-A9dbTb4TfdmnhdGhqaJqBoyvSc2_i9Ud4kXF9orDc5DyQsvEC7mp6zXD_3ill6e85sdITU4mCP7XtVSlv8S9zryTGLeh2HDMaCi2KAAbXAic9gs9Fih3uW3nI695nHFqJGMd774xLr14vuMjKzhpaA1PwNkgOD_ZUYogIJdWMVrj6-Zlg5CD-7-hlg-7-uQg%3D%3D)
__To make matters worse: the right of parents to choose how and where their kids receive their education remains out of reach for most American families.

And this is exactly why we created our Little Patriots program--to give parents, grandparents, teachers, and caregivers a free online resource they can use to teach children unbiased civics lessons, history, and American values, anywhere and anytime--[completely free of charge.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3cb154a5f8914f009dd18b3bd9616aae&_e=O_8iRC_cez4GF4PHSQMGOggkn1iBicKJVv3iAf9P1FGFy7X_NbITz5vXwG6w8l7LUXq5H3UiS0Dmw9LZtJ6wvatXR-c6qvcBWD5YKPOWGr31z8FRt7PGJGZuOUfHFUFrE54xPQpbbLw4IAhzbqhCmS6iTBKWxymrC8tggqdSiZrKYp0ZLVLaJBFshXlF1vURpULH1k2PP60wIW_lSTVqp-A9dbTb4TfdmnhdGhqaJqBoyvSc2_i9Ud4kXF9orDc5CtYY_3nej458Mym3N_DckK_6jTWkb3gJdOsP-hsj0jy2IlNdHdT5a2roAf2rcmtL059_Xrzzmj_iw_-Ij-Q_B5l-XOjP1h5dcWyAAc4jnd754VZoEhzZ7g6K_2zKjhyz_T_QaFmRfJBGNRlFCpX5rA%3D%3D)

**And now we plan to do even more.**

To meet the growing demand for educational resources that teach children to love their country and its history, we're taking Little Patriots on the road to bring these educational resources to schools, churches, and community organizations!

But to help us fund this coast-to-coast effort, I need your help today.

We depend on the generous support of patriots like you to help us fund this program and share it with children and families across our great nation.

If you believe that American children deserve to receive the best education possible, [can I personally ask you to help me accomplish my goal of getting this first-of-its-kind curriculum to anyone who needs it?](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3cb154a5f8914f009dd18b3bd9616aae&_e=O_8iRC_cez4GF4PHSQMGOggkn1iBicKJVv3iAf9P1FGFy7X_NbITz5vXwG6w8l7LUXq5H3UiS0Dmw9LZtJ6wvatXR-c6qvcBWD5YKPOWGr31z8FRt7PGJGZuOUfHFUFrE54xPQpbbLw4IAhzbqhCmS6iTBKWxymrC8tggqdSiZrKYp0ZLVLaJBFshXlF1vURpULH1k2PP60wIW_lSTVqp-A9dbTb4TfdmnhdGhqaJqBoyvSc2_i9Ud4kXF9orDc53c4FcQ1TpVjNfKcWE-kUSNwh3bIj1WJE2RVWFTeMcKgwhGWAl4ZW81p6UCafUhv9qb8JCCtegDlpAAU8rPj8DzakeqVebmIFe5xY2oKS-yWmSPk-6d6RJXJ_qF3N7kJkqMxhdqvLnSJ4LdGbhmFCzg%3D%3D)

If you'd like to help me get Little Patriots to more American children, please click the link below to make your generous tax-deductible gift today:

[**https://secure.americancornerstone.org/little-patriots-tour-donate**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3cb154a5f8914f009dd18b3bd9616aae&_e=O_8iRC_cez4GF4PHSQMGOggkn1iBicKJVv3iAf9P1FGFy7X_NbITz5vXwG6w8l7LUXq5H3UiS0Dmw9LZtJ6wvatXR-c6qvcBWD5YKPOWGr31z8FRt7PGJGZuOUfHFUFrE54xPQpbbLw4IAhzbqhCmS6iTBKWxymrC8tggqdSiZrKYp0ZLVLaJBFshXlF1vURpULH1k2PP60wIW_lSTVqp-A9dbTb4TfdmnhdGhqaJqBoyvSc2_i9Ud4kXF9orDc5ILyMg_VchTmArskxm01EauqnJIR1BKeufzIvj_Gn2zBACsd2e4JFHPg0REtpbsIbi2vvcDgLAL8zl7wMi07At-dCdgllzsrOMCE5hY82hWbLatDz2CLSpDRHch4NMuHXYD7qpwjG_L-OomzRFyUTQg%3D%3D)

Thank you so much for supporting these efforts--[together we can help kids across the U.S. get the education they deserve.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3cb154a5f8914f009dd18b3bd9616aae&_e=O_8iRC_cez4GF4PHSQMGOggkn1iBicKJVv3iAf9P1FGFy7X_NbITz5vXwG6w8l7LUXq5H3UiS0Dmw9LZtJ6wvatXR-c6qvcBWD5YKPOWGr31z8FRt7PGJGZuOUfHFUFrE54xPQpbbLw4IAhzbqhCmS6iTBKWxymrC8tggqdSiZrKYp0ZLVLaJBFshXlF1vURpULH1k2PP60wIW_lSTVqp-A9dbTb4TfdmnhdGhqaJqBoyvSc2_i9Ud4kXF9orDc5Y7RmPgKimxFfZKdcSgfMOZTMacWr4w5kSWj_7ctJ4aaJFejhGc6ABPLJRbQr4j6nv48wuIOsN9ZEDXJb-je0c4-vXozYJ74f_JPZe35CGf4KSKd8s38Ktjf1hz1ynDwXd0B43bExKHs27iQxKo4KFw%3D%3D)

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson

## Together, we can change the landscape of America.
---
America needs a green future, and that includes rural America. No Dem Left Behind has the answer on how to go green across America.
|
---
Democrats are pushing for a better relationship with the environment, and rural America can be at the forefront of this sustainable progress. Well-thought-out city planning is not just for urban cities. Rural America needs to be a part of this change, and No Dem Left Behind has actionable policy initiatives that can be used across the United States:
* **City Parks:** Allowing nature in the center of our towns. Making space in city planning for city parks will improve the landscape of our towns and improve our relationship with local nature.

* **Community Gardens:** Making the landscape more green and providing food for communities. Using public areas to grow valuable produce will improve communities in a multitude of ways.

* **Green Roofing:** Restoring nature in places we have never thought before. Current roofing features can be used to establish gardens, plant trees, and can be used to reduce temperatures in urban and rural areas.

* **Planting Trees:** It doesn't get more simple than this. Trees reduce carbon emissions, reduce temperatures in towns, and

In movies, we often see futuristic cities portrayed as chrome skyscrapers and endless concrete. However, the real future of cities should be different. It's time to integrate nature back into our towns and cities, creating a landscape where nature thrives alongside modern innovations. Imagine a future where parks, community gardens, green roofs, planting soils, and tree-lined streets are seamlessly incorporated. This shift from the bleak scenes of chrome and concrete to vibrant environments can enhance the lives of Americans and redefine our approach to city planning.
